news.Title: 台股狂飆真的人人發大財？內行人吐心聲：賠錢的不敢講
news.Content: 財經中心／綜合報導 受惠於 AI 熱潮持續席捲全球，台股屢創新高、行情強強滾，網路上不時能看到投資神人曬出獲利驚人的對帳單，甚至有不少人開槓桿翻倍大賺。不過，這般榮景也讓部分網友心生疑惑，好奇真的人人都搭上這波飆漲列車發大財了嗎？貼文曝光後，隨即引發大批鄉民熱烈討論。 受惠於 AI 熱潮持續席捲全球，台股屢創新高。（圖／民視新聞網） 一名網友在 PTT 發文 表示，近一年多來常常在版上看到神人分享對帳單，稱在 AI 浪潮帶動下台股飆漲，自己賺了多少錢，甚至有人開槓桿操作，營造出一種「每個人都發大財」的盛況，認為市場上應該還是有做空、追高或買高賣低的投資人，好奇「真的每個人都發大財嗎？還是賠錢的人心情鬱悶，賺錢的發文、賠錢的根本不發文？」他更進一步發問，難道真的大多數人都賺錢，而且獲利都是 100％ 起跳？「非得 100 萬變成 2000 萬才算合格？都沒有人被洗出去嗎？」。 原PO好奇，常常在版上看到有神人貼對帳單，但「這一年來真的多數都賺錢嗎？」。（圖／翻攝自PTT） 貼文一出，吸引眾多網友留言發表看法。有一派網友認同原 PO，指出這純粹是典型的「倖存者偏差」，「倖存者偏差，賠錢的不會講」、「賠錢的不不好意思說 QQ」、「跟親戚才會說賠錢的部分」。也有苦主與內行人分享，若操作不當或做空依然可能慘敗，「 今年停損＋空手＋做空＝賠錢 」、「會賠錢的就是槓桿停損仔（我）」、「身邊沒人賠錢，只有愛玩個股的沒賺到錢」。 然而，絕大多數網友則認為，在這種世紀大多頭行情下，想虧損反而比較難，「大盤漲了 70％，大部分人都賺錢很正常，只是未必賺到 70％ 而言」、「今年不適用二八法則，99％ 台灣人都賺錢」、「閉著眼睛買電子股 ETF 都賺錢，賺多賺少而已」。

news.Title: Roadster Hype Can't Mask TSLA's Margin & FCF Woes Before Q3 Earnings
news.Content:
Tesla TSLA and its CEO Elon Musk know how to command a stage. Yesterday's Roadster event featured rocket-assisted flips, a car launching off a ramp, and Musk declaring that the future includes flying cars. But the stock's real test is the earnings report on Oct. 21, and no stunt can change the mood heading into the release.

Impressive and a Bit Gimmicky, Roadster Is Years Away

The demo was designed to dazzle and Tesla's loyal fans were certain to lap it up. The Roadster climbed a giant curved ramp, clung to it with a fan-based suction system until it was upside down, then used cold-gas thrusters developed with SpaceX SPCX to launch, flip in midair and land cleanly. In a second stunt, it vaulted over a row of cars and a semi-truck. The Roadster was shown hitting 60 mph in under a second, though the 230-mph top speed is Musk's claim for certain versions.

Tesla is already taking money. A "Performance" reservation needs a $50,000 deposit, the "Thrust" version with acceleration thrusters needs $250,000, and an invite-only single-seat "Rocket" variant promises a full flight system.

Yet production isn't expected until 2028, nearly a decade after the car was first unveiled in 2017. For a company under margin and free cash flow pressure and pivoting toward robotics and self-driving, we might as well dismiss the Roadster demo as engineering showmanship that adds little to the business.

TSLA's Reality: Deliveries Held Up, Profits Not Likely To

Tesla's third-quarter deliveries of 486,532 beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate of 471,262 and marked Tesla's best quarter in a year. Deliveries were still 2.1% below the same quarter last year, but that was a period inflated by Americans rushing to buy before federal EV tax credits expired.

The concern is that the volume isn't turning into profit. In the second quarter of 2026, automotive gross margin (excluding regulatory credits) slid to 16.3% amid persistent price cuts. The energy storage business, once a bright spot, saw margins collapse from 39.5% to 20.4%. Selling more while earning less on each sale is worrying for investors.

The Rising Bill for TSLA's Future Bets

Meanwhile, spending is climbing. Capital expenditure is expected to exceed $25 billion in 2026. Second-quarter 2026 FCF turned negative to $1.09 billion, and the metric will be under pressure in the near term.

Capex is going into autonomy, AI, robotics and manufacturing capacity. Optimus is still early-stage, and Cybercab is only starting to scale. Both may pay off someday, but for now they are expenses, and Tesla hasn't offered a clear timeline for when they will produce meaningful returns.

Story Continues

The Valuation Gap We Can't Ignore

The share price assumes autonomy and robotics will become major profit engines. The businesses funding those bets, cars and energy storage, are earning less. The distance between what investors expect and what Tesla is currently delivering is the biggest risk, and a rich valuation leaves little room to defend it. Tesla carries a Value Score of F. Analysts appear to sense this, with earnings estimates being trimmed ahead of the report.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

The Bottom Line

The Roadster might be creating buzz, but a flying demo can't repair shrinking margins, and a 2028 launch date can't pay this year's bills. Musk may be excited, and so may Tesla's faithful, but earnings are where the numbers get tested.

With margins sliding, spending rising and estimates falling, the risk heading into third-quarter results looks tilted to the downside.

The stock currently carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell).

news.Title: TTM Technologies to Report Q3 Earnings: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
news.Content:
TTM Technologies TTMI is slated to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market opens on Oct. 22.

For the third quarter of 2026, TTMI expects net sales between $1.10 billion and $1.14 billion. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for revenues is pegged at $1.13 billion, indicating a 50.02% increase from the year-ago quarter's reported figure.

TTM Technologies expects non-GAAP earnings between $1.21 and $1.27 per share. The consensus mark for earnings is pegged at $1.25 per share, which has remained stable over the past 30 days. However, this marks robust year-over-year growth of 86.57%.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

TTMI's Earnings Surprise History

The company has a consistent track record of positive earnings surprises, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate in each of the past four quarters and delivering an average earnings surprise of 8.51%.

Q3 Earnings Whispers for TTMI Stock

Our proven model does not conclusively predict an earnings beat for TTM Technologies this time around. According to the Zacks model, the combination of a positive Earnings ESP and a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), 2 (Buy) or 3 (Hold) increases the odds of an earnings beat. However, this is not the case here, as you can see below.

TTMI has an Earnings ESP of 0.00% at present and a Zacks Rank #3. You can uncover the best stocks to buy or sell before they are reported with our Earnings ESP Filter.

What to Expect From TTMI's Q3 Results

TTM Technologies is expected to have benefited from robust demand for AI data centers and networking infrastructure in the third quarter of 2026. The company reported 91% year-over-year growth in this end market in the second quarter and expects it to contribute approximately 49% of third-quarter sales, up from 40% in the preceding quarter. The ramp-up of N+M asymmetrical interconnect printed circuit boards, supported by completed Phase 1 factory expansions, is likely to have further boosted sales. The company also indicated that the N+M production ramp-up should support adjusted EBITDA margin improvement as production volumes and yields increase.

TTM Technologies is expected to have gained from strong aerospace and defense (A&D) demand, supported by increasing defense budgets and robust bookings across strategic programs. The company's $1.7 billion defense backlog and 1.3 book-to-bill ratio exiting the second quarter provide healthy revenue visibility. Programs involving Golden Dome, APS-153 maritime surveillance radar and ATP Sensor Systems are likely to have supported performance. Moreover, the initial production ramp of Ultra-High-Density Interconnect (Ultra-HDI) products at its new Syracuse facility during the third quarter is expected to have strengthened its advanced defense electronics capabilities.

The Medical, Industrial and Instrumentation end market is expected to have contributed positively to TTM Technologies' third-quarter performance. Strong demand for continuous glucose monitoring devices, surgical robotics and electrophysiology solutions is likely to have supported medical revenues. Growing adoption of automated test equipment supporting AI applications is anticipated to have strengthened instrumentation demand. The segment recorded 33% year-over-year growth in the preceding quarter, while management projected 35-40% growth for full-year 2026. These favorable demand trends are expected to have supported revenue growth in the quarter under review.

However, TTM Technologies is likely to have faced pressure from its automotive business in the quarter under review. Management expects automotive to account for approximately 6% of third-quarter sales, down from 8% in the previous quarter, reflecting continued weakness and limited availability of certain supply chain materials. Copper-clad laminate producers are shifting away from lower-complexity materials toward higher-complexity products, creating potential supply constraints. Although TTMI is working with suppliers to secure adequate materials, these challenges could have restricted sales opportunities and affected production flexibility in the quarter to be reported.

TTMI's Stock Price Performance & Valuation

news.Title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq mixed to cap volatile week
news.Content: US stock were little changed on Friday as investors tried to look past AI trade-financing worries and turned their focus to upcoming earnings next week. The Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) gained 0.6%, while the Nasdaq 100 ( ^IXIC ) fell 0.5% and the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) remained little changed. All three major averages closed in the green on Thursday. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq were on track for weekly losses after a sell-off in chips earlier this week. The Dow, meanwhile, was on pace to finish the week up roughly 1%. Semiconductor stocks edged lower following a volatile week for the sector, a key driver of this year's AI trade. Shares of Nvidia-backed CoreWeave ( CRWV ) came under pressure again on Friday amid concerns over its debt-heavy balance sheet. The stock rebounded on Thursday after Nvidia ( NVDA ) CEO Jensen Huang voiced optimism about the neocloud provider. Investors have been rotating out of Tech ( XLK ) and into defensive sectors such as Health Care ( XLV ), which climbed to record highs. Tesla ( TSLA ) shares rose more than 1% after the EV maker unveiled a jaw-dropping redesign of the Roadster . Earnings season continues with Tesla on deck for next week. Streaming giant Netflix ( NFLX ) and social media giant Meta ( META ) will also post quarterly results. LIVE 9 updates 26 mins ago Jared Blikre Warsh stays quiet as October hike bets fade and inflation broadens Fed chair Kevin Warsh isn't committing to another rate hike this month, and traders are increasingly betting he'll wait — despite inflation data showing price pressures reaching more of the economy. The odds of an October hike are falling to roughly 15%, according to Bloomberg's bond futures pricing, down from 33% after Wednesday's hot consumer price report and 24% before its release. That retreat began before Warsh spoke at the IMF gathering in Bangkok, where he declined to preview the Fed's next decision . "I don't prejudge meetings," he said. Treasury yields are retreating too. The 10-year yield ( ^TNX ) is hovering near 5.07%, roughly 29 basis points below its October 7 intraday high. The 30-year yield ( ^TYX ) is near 5.42%, down roughly 32 basis points from its peak that same day. Both are edging lower again today. The inflation details are less reassuring. Bank of America calculates that 55% of the core consumer price basket is experiencing three-month annualized increases above 2.5%. Its economists still expect an October hike. That connects to a concern Warsh raised at Jackson Hole in August : how widespread price increases remain. His analysis examined a different inflation measure, personal consumption expenditures, but similarly looked beyond the headline number to gauge underlying pressures. Traders aren't abandoning further tightening. Futures still price roughly one quarter-point hike by December. Watch whether inflation pressures keep broadening when the government releases its PCE inflation report on October 29 following the next Fed decision the day before. 51 mins ago Jared Blikre Visa, Mastercard hit records as chips sink Nearly four in five S&P 500 stocks are advancing this morning, with Visa ( V ) and Mastercard ( MA ) among the companies reaching record highs even as chip stocks extend their selloff. Advancers are outnumbering decliners by nearly 4 to 1, with nearly 400 stocks higher and about 100 lower. Ten of the 11 S&P 500 sectors are gaining, led by financials ( XLF ) and energy ( XLE ). New intraday highs are stretching well beyond the payments sector. MetLife ( MET ), McKesson ( MCK ) and Expeditors International ( EXPD ) are also setting records, alongside ConocoPhillips ( COP ) and Box ( BOX ). The Dow Jones US consumer finance ( ^DJUSSF ) and reinsurance ( ^DJUSIU ) indexes are joining them. Chips remain a different story. The iShares Semiconductor ETF ( SOXX ) is losing more than 2%, setting up for a ninth straight decline — the first since 2006. In a Yahoo Finance semiconductor basket, 57 of 60 stocks are falling. Watch whether the broad buying holds through the session. That would strengthen the case that investors are finding alternatives to the struggling AI leaders. Today at 1:34 PM UTC David Hollerith Stocks open Friday mixed US stocks largely held steady at Friday's open as investors looked for direction after a turbulent past few days. At Friday's open, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) gained 0.4% while the the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) gained 0.1% and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) fell 0.3%. For the week through Thursday, the Dow is up while the Nasdaq is down and the S&P 500 is slightly lower. Today at 1:17 PM UTC Jared Blikre CoreWeave’s bear trap offers fresh bulls hope CoreWeave ( CRWV ) may have trapped fresh bears Thursday. This morning's pullback is testing the bulls. The stock is falling about 5% before the bell after Thursday's dramatic reversal. The stock briefly broke below $60, near its late-July lows, before recovering to finish nearly 6% higher. That's a bear trap — a breakdown that reverses, catching traders betting on further losses. This morning, shares have retraced roughly half the advance from Thursday's low to the overnight high. For technicians, that puts a potential entry for fresh bulls around the midpoint of the rebound — near $65 and change. "First of all, this is more sentiment driven. This is not about fundamentals," BofA Securities senior software analyst Tal Liani told Yahoo Finance when asked what would stop CoreWeave's selling. Liani maintained a Buy rating and $140 price target despite the financing concerns, as my colleague Brian Sozzi reported . The big test remains $60. Holding above it would keep the bear trap intact. A sustained recovery would bring potential resistance around $92–$93 into view, then $120. Losing Thursday's low at $60 would undermine the bullish setup. Today at 1:10 PM UTC David Hollerith Strategy shares fall over 3% as Saylor's bitcoin giant faces index-level threat Stock in Michael Saylor's bitcoin juggernaut Strategy ( MSTR ) fell more than 3% in pre-market trading on Friday after index provider MSCI announced new eligibility rules that could lead to the removal of the bitcoin giant from its global stock indexes. MSCI said Thursday it will adopt new rules to exclude certain "non-operating companies" from its indexes, including those whose primary business resembles that of an investment fund rather than a traditional operating company. Exclusion could include Strategy, the world's largest corporate holder of bitcoin, along with other digital asset treasury companies such as MetaPlanet. Exclusion is expected to force index-tracking funds to sell shares of affected companies. MSCI said it will publish a final list of affected companies on Nov. 11, with the new rules taking effect after the market closes on Nov. 30. Strategy, led by executive chairman Saylor, has previously criticized the proposal as discriminatory against digital asset treasury companies. The company currently holds about 4% of bitcoin's total supply. Today at 12:58 PM UTC Jared Blikre Stocks broadly gaining pre-market as chip selloff continues More S&P 500 stocks are rising than falling before the bell. Chip stocks are still largely heading south. Advancers among S&P 500 constituents are outnumbering decliners by more than 2 to 1, with 224 higher, 106 lower and 173 unchanged. S&P 500 futures ( ES=F ) are edging higher while Nasdaq futures ( NQ=F ) slip. Both remain negative on the week. The stealth stock buying seen this morning extends a broader rotation. Through Thursday, 366 of the S&P's components — 73% — were higher for the week. Since October 6, nearly 70% had advanced, even as the index lost roughly 1%. Chips remain under pressure. The iShares Semiconductor ETF ( SOXX ) is falling over 1%, putting a ninth straight loss in play. Its only previous nine-session losing streak ended in May 2006. The fund subsequently fell another 17% through its July closing low two decades ago. Meanwhile, Salesforce ( CRM ) and ServiceNow ( NOW ) are each adding more than 1% after Thursday's rallies. Buyers are lifting 33 of 45 stocks in a Yahoo Finance software basket. Software — ex-cybersecurity — has been a source of strength recently, contrasting with the semis trade. Watch whether that participation survives the opening bell. Continued buying beyond chips would show investors are sticking with alternatives to the struggling leaders. Today at 12:33 PM UTC David Hollerith Regional bank stock Truist falls after 3Q profits miss Shares of Truist Financial ( TFC ) fell more than 2% pre-market after the regional banking giant posted third quarter profits that fell short of analyst expectations. The Charlotte, North Carolina-based lender reported adjusted earnings of $1.16 per share, up 12% from a year earlier but below the $1.19 expected by analysts, according to RBC Capital Markets. Reported earnings were $0.56 per share, reflecting a $1.4 billion loss from selling bonds as part of an effort to reposition its balance sheet. Truist's stock has lagged its rivals since it was born of a so-called merger of equals between BB&T and SunTrust, which closed in December 2019. The bank has since continued to overhaul parts of its business. Truist reported net interest income of $3.66 billion in the third quarter, up slightly from a year ago. The bank also said it moved to further simplify operations in the quarter. Earlier this week, Truist sold $7.7 billion in unsecured consumer loans to private equity giant Carlyle Group. That comes after it sold $5.5 billion in near-prime auto loans to Apollo Global Management last month. (Disclosure: Yahoo is a portfolio company of funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management.) "We delivered a solid quarter while also taking decisive actions to better position Truist for the future," the bank's new CEO Mike Lyons said in a statement. Today at 12:30 PM UTC Ines Ferré The US economy is facing two hot wars heating up at a bad time for the White House Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley reports: Yields are above multi-decade highs , both gas and diesel prices continue to climb , and critical midterm elections are around the corner. Adding to pressure on the US economy and the current administration, the world's two largest hot wars are heating up. In the Middle East, dual fronts along the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea have seen a resurgence of conflict in recent weeks that heavily disrupted oil flows in the region. Multiple tankers and container ships in the Strait of Hormuz either caught fire or sank this week in the Iran-dominated waterway. The Washington Institute has tracked more than two dozen attacks recorded since the start of the month. Today at 11:47 AM UTC Ines Ferré Tesla stock pops after unveiling Roadster with compressed air thrusters for limited flight Yahoo Finance's Pras Subramanian reports: After a two-week delay, the Tesla ( TSLA ) Roadster event went off with a massive bang — a flying one. The wedge-shaped, cyberpunk-looking Roadster EV appeared in front of an inverted half roller coaster ramp erected at SpaceX's facility in Waco, Texas. The Roadster cruised halfway up — glued to the ramp using a vacuum fan system — then launched off the ramp upside down and performed flips in the air, using air thrusters to right itself and land on the tarmac. Tesla stock rose as much as 5.4% during premarket trading on Friday following the Roadster event. LIVE 9 updates

news.Title: 《強勢美股特報》HST,NUE,AZO,SLB等10檔
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-16 22:12:34 數位內容中心 發佈

Host Hotels & Resorts（HST.US）： 成交價24.6美元，上漲3.15%，開盤24.03美元，盤中高點24.62美元，盤中低點24.03美元，均價24.44美元，成交量6.5萬股。

Nucor（NUE.US）： 成交價261.9美元，上漲2.83%，開盤257.16美元，盤中高點263.76美元，盤中低點257.16美元，均價258.24美元，成交量6.55萬股。

Nucor近期最明確的變化，是鋼價走高與電弧爐成本優勢持續擴大利差。公司2026年第2季EBITDA達20.2億美元，鋼廠出貨量創710萬噸新高；同季淨銷貨103.97億美元、毛利率升至19.6%，公司並預期第3季鋼廠與鋼鐵製品部門獲利將進一步增加。

AutoZone（AZO.US）： 成交價3137美元，上漲2.53%，開盤3091美元，盤中高點3144.99美元，盤中低點3087.35美元，均價3118.28美元，成交量2696股。

AutoZone的成長重心正更明顯轉向商用維修通路。公司2026會計年度全年營收首度站上203億美元，第4季稀釋每股盈餘56.05美元，國內商用同店銷售成長8.6%，明顯優於本土DIY客群的0.6%下滑。公司全年新開374家門市，並規劃2027會計年度再增約400家。

SLB（SLB.US）： 成交價49.75美元，上漲2.84%，開盤49.01美元，盤中高點49.77美元，盤中低點48.9美元，均價49.15美元，成交量60.92萬股。

news.Title: 外資爆砍461億大逃殺！郭哲榮曝「逢低布局」契機：台股第四季勝率九成
news.Content:
台股今（16）日加權指數收在 47,111.26 點，上漲 141.39 點，成交值為新台幣 9,359.59 億元；護國神山 台積電（2330） 於法說會後股價拉回，收盤下跌 20 元至 2,420 元。根據臺灣證券交易所最新籌碼動態，外資今日在現貨市場再度大舉賣超 461.47 億元，已連續 8 個交易日對台股站在賣方，累計提款高達 6,817 億元。面對外資大逃殺與新台幣匯率一度重貶突破 32.5 元關卡， 摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮 卻發出震撼市場的大膽預測，強調依據近十年第四季高達九成的上漲勝率，籌碼清洗過後，年底大盤依然有實力挑戰 5 萬點大關。

【外資爆砍461億！央行出手戲劇性阻貶】

今日台北股市上演一場讓萬千股民心跳加速的震撼大戲。盤中雖試圖強勢反彈，但尾盤遭逢無情壓低，市場背後最大的推手正是外資單日狂砍 461 億元的龐大拋售潮。伴隨資金外流，新台幣匯率今日盤中一度重貶超過 2.55 角，跌破 32.5 關卡來到 32.52 兌 1 美元。所幸接近午盤時央行戲劇性出手阻貶，加上外資陸續回頭，終場新台幣以 32.338 元作收，微幅升值 7.3 分。摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮指出，雖然資金出現實質性外逃壓力，但比起早已跌破四萬點位階的韓國股市與陷入頭部型態的美國費城半導體指數，台股表現依然展現出極強的抗跌韌性。

【台積電法說超強卻拉回？AI過熱疑慮與籌碼洗盤】

許多投資人困惑，為何台積電（2330）法說會公布亮眼財報與展望，股價卻不給力？關鍵在於短線籌碼極度混亂，加上部分資金對 AI 產業是否過熱產生顧慮。郭哲榮分析，AI 技術雖然成熟並將陸續取代傳統人力，但從技術到位到全面落地深耕仍需要時間。這段「轉型過渡期」反而為股市提供了持續推升的想像空間，一如特斯拉執行長馬斯克靠著夢想支撐高估值與創新變革，市場的想像力永遠是股價最堅實的後盾。

【歷史勝率高達九成！第四季挑戰5萬點佈局時機】

面對眼前的震盪，盲目恐慌往往是吞噬獲利的元凶。郭哲榮強調，根據近十年歷史數據統計， 台股第四季上漲機率高達九成，平均漲幅近 6% 。計算目前大盤位階，只要第四季展現正常的旺季拉升力道，年底衝刺 5 萬點目標並非遙不可及。

在具體個股佈局上，郭哲榮點出，矽晶圓龍頭環球晶（6488）若跌破千元大關（如 1,000 元以下）、中美晶（5483）在 200 元以下，均呈現分批進場的吸引力；而權值股鴻海（2317）本益比僅約 12 倍，評價面亦相當實惠。只要投資人能保持紀律、不被短線洗盤嚇退，這波外資提款反而提供了難得的逢低佈局契機。

news.Title: TSMC's Record Q3 Earnings & Upbeat Outlook Put These ETFs in Focus
news.Content:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. TSM reported record third-quarter earnings that exceeded analyst expectations, as robust global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) chips continued to drive growth at the world's largest contract chipmaker.

TSMC Beats Q3 Earnings Estimates

TSMC's third-quarter revenues of NT$1.49 trillion ($46.36 billion) topped the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $45.62 billion. TSMC reported third-quarter 2026 earnings per share (EPS) of $4.60, ahead of the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $4.45.

TSMC's net profit climbed 68.7% year over year, marking its sixth consecutive quarter of record earnings, per CNBC. Its operating margin reached 58.7%, surpassing the upper end of the company's guidance range of 58%. The strong margin performance highlights TSMC's pricing power amid surging demand for advanced semiconductors.

Strong Q4 Outlook Signals Sustained AI Momentum

TSMC expects fourth-quarter revenues of $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion. At the midpoint, the forecast implies a 14% sequential increase and a 58% jump from the year-ago quarter, according to the company's earnings call. The forecast beats the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $48.78 billion.

The chipmaker also expects capital expenditure during 2026-2028 to be significantly higher than in the preceding three years as it expands capacity to meet rising customer demand.

The company expects fourth-quarter growth to be supported by continued demand for its advanced manufacturing technologies, including the ramp-up of its 2-nanometer process.

Advanced Chips and AI Drive Revenue Mix

Advanced technologies, defined as 7-nanometer and more advanced processes, accounted for 79% of TSMC's total wafer revenue in the third quarter.

Among individual process technologies, 3-nanometer chips generated the largest share of revenue at 33%, followed by 5-nanometer and 7-nanometer chips.

High-performance computing was TSMC's largest revenue-generating platform, contributing 68% of total revenue.

TSMC said demand for AI chips remains strong, thanks to the expanding adoption of agentic AI and open-source AI models. These developments could broaden AI adoption and increase demand for advanced semiconductors.

The company also highlighted growing demand for AI accelerators, processors used in agentic AI applications and networking. It expects semiconductors to play an increasingly important role in the global AI supply chain.

Free Cash Flow Surges as U.S. Expansion Advances

TSMC's free cash flow rose sharply to NT$476.56 billion in the third quarter, compared with NT$139.38 billion a year earlier, reflecting a substantial improvement in cash generation.

Story Continues

On the manufacturing front, the company said it had completed construction of its second fabrication plant in Arizona and was installing equipment. Mass production is expected to begin in the third quarter of 2027, slightly ahead of the previous schedule.

TSMC's board also approved a cash dividend of NT$7 per share for the second quarter.

TSMC ETFs in Focus

Overall, TSMC's record profitability, robust revenue outlook and plans for increased capital expenditure underscore its confidence in the long-term growth of AI-related semiconductor demand.

Apart from the TSMC stock itself, investors can play it in ETF form. The TSMC-heavy ETFs include SP Funds S&P World (ex-US) ETF SPWO (TSMC's weight 20%), Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF JHAI (about 15% exposure) and Matthews Asia Dividend Active ETF ADVE (about 14% focus).

news.Content:
美股周五(16日)開盤漲跌互現，本周朝收黑邁進。市場對人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮的疑慮持續壓抑半導體股，科技與AI相關類股本周走弱，讓投資人保持謹慎；特斯拉(TSLA-US)上漲則為大盤提供部分支撐。

美股科技股歷經一周重挫後，股指期貨周五小幅走高，但投資人仍保持謹慎。市場同時消化資金撤出人工智慧(AI)交易、美債強勢反彈，以及通膨高於預期等變化，標普500指數期貨上漲0.1%，晶片股盤前持續承壓。

news.Title: 台積電CoWoS助力　輝達RTX Spark電腦強攻高階市場
news.Content:
（中央社記者吳家豪台北2026年10月16日電）搭載輝達（NVIDIA）新一代AI超級晶片RTX Spark的個人電腦（PC）今天開賣，台灣為少數舉辦實體派對的重點市場之一。輝達主管今天在台受訪指出，儘管零組件與記憶體價格飆漲，但市場早期需求卻呈現「直攻頂規」的現象，高度集中在64GB與128GB記憶體的高階版本。

輝達個人運算業務資深副總裁費雪（Jeff Fisher）強調，RTX Spark不僅是輝達與IC設計大廠聯發科 (2454) 深度聯手打造的劃時代PC產品，更是輝達首度將過去僅限於資料中心等級的台積電 (2330) CoWoS先進封裝技術導入PC產品，宣告PC硬體架構迎來全新變革。

費雪說，RTX Spark今晚展開全球巡迴慶祝，除了台灣之外，也將陸續在首爾、北京、柏林、舊金山與伊斯坦堡等少數國際指標城市登場，「我們預期各地都將迎來強勁需求」。

費雪直言，要談論PC生態系，絕對離不開台灣，無論是台灣的品牌廠（OEM）還是代工廠（ODM），都是這波新產品問世的關鍵力量，台灣無疑是這款產品最重要的市場之一。

當前全球電子產業面臨成本考驗，費雪坦言，從記憶體、晶圓產能到印刷電路板（PCB）等零組件供應普遍吃緊，終端售價難免需要反映；然而，人工智慧（AI）浪潮正顛覆過往消費者對PC價格的敏感度。

費雪透露，根據早期需求數據，RTX Spark電腦買氣高度集中在64GB與128GB記憶體的高階機型。投入AI的開發者追求本地端強大算力，願意跨越價格門檻採購頂級機種，他預期RTX Spark將成為「輝達有史以來最成功的產品之一」。

在晶片架構方面，費雪稱讚聯發科擁有「世界級的中央處理器（CPU）設計團隊」，當初輝達構思這款產品時，核心理念就是將頂級RTX繪圖處理器（GPU）與具備極高能源效率的CPU整合，並搭配統一記憶體。這也具體落實了輝達對聯發科的長期投資承諾，雙方合作版圖已從PC延伸至資料中心基礎設施。

值得注意的是，為實現高階本地端AI算力，RTXSpark是輝達首度採用台積電CoWoS先進封裝的PC產品。

費雪解釋，過去輝達GeForce顯示卡晶片普遍採用單晶粒（Single die），但RTX Spark為雙晶粒（Twodie）設計，記憶體直接掛載於CPU，GPU若要即時發揮效能，必須具備極高速的記憶體存取能力。因此，輝達透過NVLink C2C晶片對晶片互連高頻寬技術，將CPU與GPU緊密相連，並以CoWoS進行先進封裝。

費雪表示，雖然CoWoS產能整體吃緊，但RTXSpark的晶粒尺寸相較於伺服器晶片明顯更小，因此CoWoS並不會成為供貨瓶頸；這也讓RTX Spark成為首款成功將資料中心級封裝技術落實到個人電腦的產品。

針對先進晶片受到出口管制的中國市場，費雪指出，中國是目前全球AI開發最蓬勃、最活躍的市場之一，學生、愛好者及開發人員正積極在終端設備上構建令人驚豔的專案。RTX Spark除了首波推出的筆電，未來1個月還將推出小型主機形態的設備，輝達正與品牌業者緊密合作，盡快確保各種規格機種在中國市場的供貨，對當地需求抱持高度期待。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: First Week of Q3 Earnings in the Books
news.Content:
Friday, October 16th, 2026

The first full week of Q3 earnings season is nearly complete, and results are somewhat mixed so far. As Zacks Director of Research Sheraz Mian said earlier this week in his Earnings Trends release, early Q3 reports are "tracking modestly below" recent quarters over the same time period.

Pre-market futures are mixed slightly again this morning, with the Dow — looking to close higher for its second-straight week — up +27 points, the tech-(and AI-)heavy Nasdaq — hoping to avoid its worst trading week since July — is down -42 points. The S&P 500 splitting the difference at +11 points. The small-cap Russell 2000 is presently +4 points.

Imports & Exports Bring Us 3rd Higher Inflation Print of the Week

September Import Prices from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) came in at their highest rate since May: +1.1%, versus expectations of +0.8%, and more than double the previous month's downwardly revised +0.5%. Subtracting potentially volatile fuel prices, this number adjusts to +0.8% — still higher than expected. Year over year, +8.1% is the most expensive Imports month since July of 2022. Ex-petrol, this only drops to +6.0%.

Exports rose +2.2% last month, up from +1.2% posted for August. Agriculture exports grew by the highest number since November of 2022. Year over year, exports blossomed to +11.6%. While it's good to see Exports earn more than Imports, we're still looking at higher global inflation numbers, when it's all said and done.

New York Fed Sees Sharp Decline in Services

Also out this morning is the October Services report from the Federal Reserve of New York : -20.7 is well below the -4.1 analysts were expecting, and hitting its lowest level since March of this year. This follows -8.7 print from September. This is the most rapid selling price since 2022, on weaker cap ex spending. There is also a pessimistic outlook for the tri-state (NY, NJ, CT) area. Compare this with the robust +25.5 posted in the Empire State manufacturing report earlier this week.

Q3 Earnings at a Glance: TRV, RF & More

Dow component The Travelers TRV stormed the gates in Q3 earnings this morning, posting a +29.84% earnings surprise to $9.18 per share (from an expected $7.07). Revenues of $12.45 billion were modestly higher than the Zacks consensus, and almost flat year over year. Shares are down -3% on the news, giving back some of its +32% gains year to date. For more on TRV's earnings, click here.

Elsewhere, we saw quarterly reports from regional banks Regions Financial RF, Citizens Financial Group CFG and M&T Bank MTB. All three beat on earnings: +8.96%, +2.17% and +2.01%, respectively, but only Regions is higher in pre-market trading following the releases, with shares up +1.2%.

Next week, earnings season shifts to a higher gear, with Netflix NFLX — which just announced a replacement of its CCO from Bela Bajaria to entertainment exec Peter Rice — joining Tesla TSLA reporting after Tuesday's close. On Thursday, we'll see Q3 results from Meta Platforms META, General Motors GM and Intuitive Surgical ISRG.

news.Title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq mixed amid volatile week
news.Content: US stock were little changed on Friday as investors looked past AI trade-financing worries and turned their focus to upcoming earnings next week. The Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) gained 0.3%, while the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) gained 0.3% and the Nasdaq 100 ( ^IXIC ) edged slightly lower after all three major averages closed in the green on Thursday. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq were on track for weekly losses after a sell-off in chips earlier this week. The Dow, meanwhile, was on pace to finish the week up roughly 1%. Semiconductor stocks edged lower following a volatile week for the sector, a key driver of this year's AI trade. Shares of Nvidia-backed CoreWeave ( CRWV ) came under pressure this week amid concerns over its debt-heavy balance sheet. The stock rebounded on Thursday after Nvidia ( NVDA ) CEO Jensen Huang voiced optimism about the neocloud provider. Investors have been rotating out of Tech ( XLK ) and into defensive sectors such as Health Care ( XLV ), which climbed to record highs. Bonds have also attracted buying interest, with the 10-year Treasury yield (^ TNX ) hovering near 5.09% In pre-market trading, Tesla ( TSLA ) shares popped 3% after the EV maker unveiled a jaw-dropping redesign of the Roadster . Earnings season continues with Tesla on deck for next week. Streaming giant Netflix ( NFLX ) and social media giant Meta ( META ) will also post quarterly results. LIVE 7 updates 2 mins ago David Hollerith Stocks open Friday mixed US stocks largely held steady at Friday's open as investors looked for direction after a turbulent past few days. At Friday's open, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) gained 0.4% while the the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) gained 0.1% and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) fell 0.3%. For the week through Thursday, the Dow is up while the Nasdaq is down and the S&P 500 is slightly lower 19 mins ago Jared Blikre CoreWeave’s bear trap offers fresh bulls hope CoreWeave ( CRWV ) may have trapped fresh bears Thursday. This morning's pullback is testing the bulls. The stock is falling about 5% before the bell after Thursday's dramatic reversal. The stock briefly broke below $60, near its late-July lows, before recovering to finish nearly 6% higher. That's a bear trap — a breakdown that reverses, catching traders betting on further losses. This morning, shares have retraced roughly half the advance from Thursday's low to the overnight high. For technicians, that puts a potential entry for fresh bulls around the midpoint of the rebound — near $65 and change. "First of all, this is more sentiment driven. This is not about fundamentals," BofA Securities senior software analyst Tal Liani told Yahoo Finance when asked what would stop CoreWeave's selling. Liani maintained a Buy rating and $140 price target despite the financing concerns, as my colleague Brian Sozzi reported . The big test remains $60. Holding above it would keep the bear trap intact. A sustained recovery would bring potential resistance around $92–$93 into view, then $120. Losing Thursday's low at $60 would undermine the bullish setup. 26 mins ago David Hollerith Strategy shares fall over 3% as Saylor's bitcoin giant faces index-level threat Stock in Michael Saylor's bitcoin juggernaut Strategy ( MSTR ) fell more than 3% in pre-market trading on Friday after index provider MSCI announced new eligibility rules that could lead to the removal of the bitcoin giant from its global stock indexes. MSCI said Thursday it will adopt new rules to exclude certain "non-operating companies" from its indexes, including those whose primary business resembles that of an investment fund rather than a traditional operating company. Exclusion could include Strategy, the world's largest corporate holder of bitcoin, along with other digital asset treasury companies such as MetaPlanet. Exclusion is expected to force index-tracking funds to sell shares of affected companies. MSCI said it will publish a final list of affected companies on Nov. 11, with the new rules taking effect after the market closes on Nov. 30. Strategy, led by executive chairman Saylor, has previously criticized the proposal as discriminatory against digital asset treasury companies. The company currently holds about 4% of bitcoin's total supply. 38 mins ago Jared Blikre Stocks broadly gaining pre-market as chip selloff continues More S&P 500 stocks are rising than falling before the bell. Chip stocks are still largely heading south. Advancers among S&P 500 constituents are outnumbering decliners by more than 2 to 1, with 224 higher, 106 lower and 173 unchanged. S&P 500 futures ( ES=F ) are edging higher while Nasdaq futures ( NQ=F ) slip. Both remain negative on the week. The stealth stock buying seen this morning extends a broader rotation. Through Thursday, 366 of the S&P's components — 73% — were higher for the week. Since October 6, nearly 70% had advanced, even as the index lost roughly 1%. Chips remain under pressure. The iShares Semiconductor ETF ( SOXX ) is falling over 1%, putting a ninth straight loss in play. Its only previous nine-session losing streak ended in May 2006. The fund subsequently fell another 17% through its July closing low two decades ago. Meanwhile, Salesforce ( CRM ) and ServiceNow ( NOW ) are each adding more than 1% after Thursday's rallies. Buyers are lifting 33 of 45 stocks in a Yahoo Finance software basket. Software — ex-cybersecurity — has been a source of strength recently, contrasting with the semis trade. Watch whether that participation survives the opening bell. Continued buying beyond chips would show investors are sticking with alternatives to the struggling leaders. Today at 12:33 PM UTC David Hollerith Regional bank stock Truist falls after 3Q profits miss Shares of Truist Financial ( TFC ) fell more than 2% pre-market after the regional banking giant posted third quarter profits that fell short of analyst expectations. The Charlotte, North Carolina-based lender reported adjusted earnings of $1.16 per share, up 12% from a year earlier but below the $1.19 expected by analysts, according to RBC Capital Markets. Reported earnings were $0.56 per share, reflecting a $1.4 billion loss from selling bonds as part of an effort to reposition its balance sheet. Truist's stock has lagged its rivals since it was born of a so-called merger of equals between BB&T and SunTrust, which closed in December 2019. The bank has since continued to overhaul parts of its business. Truist reported net interest income of $3.66 billion in the third quarter, up slightly from a year ago. The bank also said it moved to further simplify operations in the quarter. Earlier this week, Truist sold $7.7 billion in unsecured consumer loans to private equity giant Carlyle Group. That comes after it sold $5.5 billion in near-prime auto loans to Apollo Global Management last month. (Disclosure: Yahoo is a portfolio company of funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management.) "We delivered a solid quarter while also taking decisive actions to better position Truist for the future," the bank's new CEO Mike Lyons said in a statement. Today at 12:30 PM UTC Ines Ferré The US economy is facing two hot wars heating up at a bad time for the White House Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley reports: Yields are above multi-decade highs , both gas and diesel prices continue to climb , and critical midterm elections are around the corner. Adding to pressure on the US economy and the current administration, the world's two largest hot wars are heating up. In the Middle East, dual fronts along the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea have seen a resurgence of conflict in recent weeks that heavily disrupted oil flows in the region. Multiple tankers and container ships in the Strait of Hormuz either caught fire or sank this week in the Iran-dominated waterway. The Washington Institute has tracked more than two dozen attacks recorded since the start of the month. Today at 11:47 AM UTC Ines Ferré Tesla stock pops after unveiling Roadster with compressed air thrusters for limited flight Yahoo Finance's Pras Subramanian reports: After a two-week delay, the Tesla ( TSLA ) Roadster event went off with a massive bang — a flying one. The wedge-shaped, cyberpunk-looking Roadster EV appeared in front of an inverted half roller coaster ramp erected at SpaceX's facility in Waco, Texas. The Roadster cruised halfway up — glued to the ramp using a vacuum fan system — then launched off the ramp upside down and performed flips in the air, using air thrusters to right itself and land on the tarmac. Tesla stock rose as much as 5.4% during premarket trading on Friday following the Roadster event. LIVE 7 updates

news.Title: Wall St set for muted open as tech wobble persists; Tesla gains
news.Content:
By Tharuniyaa Lakshmi and Purvi Agarwal

Oct 16 (Reuters) - US stock index futures pointed to a subdued open on Friday, as technology stocks came under pressure once again on worries about cracks building in the ‌AI trade, though gains in Tesla offered some support.

The electric vehicle maker rose 3.3% in premarket trading after unveiling ‌a redesigned Roadster, powered by rocket-style thrusters, developed in collaboration with SpaceX.

Elon Musk's rocket and space technology company was up marginally.

Caution persisted in the AI sector ​as Nvidia-backed CoreWeave slipped 5.5%, after Thursday's rebound, on lingering concerns about the data centre operator's debt load. Its bonds sold off sharply this week, pushing yields to above 15%.

Other neocloud firms Nebius Group and Iren dipped over 3% each while chipmakers Micron Technology and Intel fell 2% and 1.6%, respectively.

AI stocks have cratered this week as investors who have crowded into bets all along the ‌AI supply chain worry that data centre ⁠operators might not turn profitable in time to repay debts, particularly with borrowing costs expected to rise.

A pullback in memory chip stocks earlier this week on rising fears of Chinese competition and ⁠concerns over CoreWeave's debt "provided investors with an excuse to cut their exposure to all AI-adjacent companies," said David Morrison, senior market analyst at Trade Nation.

"There's still some caution out there. If it is just a touch of profit-taking after yesterday's rebound, or something more serious... ​time ​will tell," said Morrison.

Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter, ​that some current Anthropic investors and prospective investors in ‌its upcoming IPO are weighing a lower valuation, amid concerns over ballooning AI financing costs.

The selloff in AI stocks sparked a rotation into defensive sectors such as healthcare on Thursday, helping the main indexes close slightly higher.

The S&P 500 and Nasdaq were set to post weekly losses as an AI-led rout, mixed earnings from big banks and inflation data weighed on sentiment through the week.

The Dow, however, remained on track for a weekly advance.

At 8:43 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were up 41 ‌points, or 0.08%, S&P 500 E-minis were up 10.5 points, or 0.13% ​and Nasdaq 100 E-minis were down 59.75 points, or 0.20%.

Oil prices steadied ​on Friday, remaining above the $100-a-barrel mark. [O/R]

Hotter-than-expected consumer and producer ​inflation reports this week have confirmed that price pressures are broadening out beyond energy products.

Story Continues

Federal Reserve ‌Chair Kevin Warsh also noted that a spending surge ​was boosting inflation. He, however, said ​the US economy remained resilient and was benefiting from an AI-driven investment boom.

Markets increasingly expect the Fed to keep interest rates unchanged this month.

Among other movers, property-casualty insurer Travelers dropped 3.2% after reporting third-quarter results.

Varonis Systems climbed ​2.8% as Thoma Bravo's Proofpoint agreed to buy ‌the data security firm in a $6.3 billion all-cash deal.

Netflix appointed former Disney executive Peter Rice as chief content officer ​on Thursday. Its shares were down 3.6% before the bell.

(Reporting by Tharuniyaa Lakshmi and Purvi Agarwal in ​Bengaluru, additional reporting by Vidya Ranganathan; Editing by Joyjeet Das)

news.Title: Apple iPhone Duo preorders sell out, deliveries extend to late January
news.Content: Preorders for Apple's ( AAPL ) $1,999 foldable iPhone Duo sold out in minutes after opening Friday, with delivery dates jumping from Oct. 23 to late January. Apple's most ambitious iPhone yet, the passport-sized Duo features a 5.4-inch front display and a 7.6-inch foldable inner screen, with a nano-texture finish that helps prevent glare while making the panel's center crease all but invisible. The book-style foldable is a first for Apple, which has sat out of the folding-phone market for years, leaving rivals Samsung ( 005930.KS ) and Google ( GOOG , GOOGL ) to grab market share and iterate on their designs. But Apple is notorious for letting other companies do the legwork to develop a new market, only to swoop in and grab its own piece of the pie. That's exactly what the iPhone maker did with the AirPods and Apple Watch, which have become bestselling devices in their respective categories. The iPhone Duo brings a number of new features to Apple's all-important product line, including the ability to run two apps side by side or two windows of the same app simultaneously. Apps seamlessly transition from the front screen to the main display and back. You can also take advantage of the Duo's foldable design by positioning it like an open laptop on your desk and viewing content on the top of the screen while navigating on the bottom half. In standing mode, you can position the Duo like a tent on a flat surface to watch shows and movies or use the phone as a high-powered clock for your nightstand. Apple has also thrown in some extras on the camera. When you unfold the phone and open the camera app, the front screen will provide your subject with a preview of your shot. The idea is to spare friends, couples, and everyone in between the awful experience of having someone take your picture, only to immediately look at the result and demand a redo. The Duo gets ultrawide-angle and wide-angle rear cameras, but no telephoto option. Up front, the phone gets Apple's Center Stage camera, which helps keep the user in view even if they move side to side. There's also a FaceTime camera hidden beneath the main folding screen. Foldable phones are still a relatively niche market segment. According to market research firm IDC , manufacturers were projected to ship 1.25 billion units in 2025. Foldables were expected to make up just 20.6 million of those. But the company said it anticipates foldable smartphones will account for roughly 10% of the market by 2029. It hit a major cumulative milestone in 2026 with total lifetime units set to surpass 100 million by the end of the year, according to Counterpoint Research's latest Foldable Smartphone Market Forecast . news.Title: How Much Upside is Left in NXP (NXPI)? Wall Street Analysts Think 31.41%
news.Content:
NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) closed the last trading session at $231.09, gaining 1.4% over the past four weeks, but there could be plenty of upside left in the stock if short-term price targets set by Wall Street analysts are any guide. The mean price target of $303.67 indicates a 31.4% upside potential.

The mean estimate comprises 26 short-term price targets with a standard deviation of $43.2. While the lowest estimate of $190.00 indicates a 17.8% decline from the current price level, the most optimistic analyst expects the stock to surge 73.1% to reach $400.00. It's very important to note the standard deviation here, as it helps understand the variability of the estimates. The smaller the standard deviation, the greater the agreement among analysts.

While the consensus price target is highly sought after by investors, the ability and unbiasedness of analysts in setting price targets have long been questionable. And investors making investment decisions solely based on this tool would arguably do themselves a disservice.

However, an impressive consensus price target is not the only factor that indicates a potential upside in NXPI. This view is strengthened by the agreement among analysts that the company will report better earnings than what they estimated earlier. Though a positive trend in earnings estimate revisions doesn't give any idea as to how much the stock could surge, it has proven effective in predicting an upside.

Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise

Here's What You May Not Know About Analysts' Price Targets

According to researchers at several universities across the globe, a price target is one of many pieces of information about a stock that misleads investors far more often than it guides. In fact, empirical research shows that price targets set by several analysts, irrespective of the extent of agreement, rarely indicate where the price of a stock could actually be heading.

While Wall Street analysts have deep knowledge of a company's fundamentals and the sensitivity of its business to economic and industry issues, many of them tend to set overly optimistic price targets. Are you wondering why?

They usually do that to drum up interest in shares of companies that their firms either have existing business relationships with or are looking to be associated with. In other words, business incentives of firms covering a stock often result in inflated price targets set by analysts.

However, a tight clustering of price targets, which is represented by a low standard deviation, indicates that analysts have a high degree of agreement about the direction and magnitude of a stock's price movement. While that doesn't necessarily mean the stock will hit the average price target, it could be a good starting point for further research aimed at identifying the potential fundamental driving forces.

Story Continues

That said, while investors should not entirely ignore price targets, making an investment decision solely based on them could lead to disappointing ROI. So, price targets should always be treated with a high degree of skepticism.

Why NXPI Could Witness a Solid Upside

Analysts' growing optimism over the company's earnings prospects, as indicated by strong agreement among them in revising EPS estimates higher, could be a legitimate reason to expect an upside in the stock. That's because empirical research shows a strong correlation between trends in earnings estimate revisions and near-term stock price movements.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year has increased 0.1% over the past month, as one estimate has gone higher compared to no negative revision.

Moreover, NXPI currently has a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), which means it is in the top 20% of more than 4,000 stocks that we rank based on four factors related to earnings estimates. Given an impressive externally-audited track record, this is a more conclusive indication of the stock's potential upside in the near term. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>> .

Therefore, while the consensus price target may not be a reliable indicator of how much NXPI could gain, the direction of price movement it implies does appear to be a good guide.

news.Title: MKS (MKSI) Forms 'Hammer Chart Pattern': Time for Bottom Fishing?
news.Content:
A downtrend has been apparent in MKS (MKSI) lately. While the stock has lost 12.2% over the past week, it could witness a trend reversal as a hammer chart pattern was formed in its last trading session. This could mean that the bulls have been able to counteract the bears to help the stock find support.

The formation of a hammer pattern is considered a technical indication of nearing a bottom with likely subsiding of selling pressure. But this is not the only factor that makes a bullish case for the stock. On the fundamental side, strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in raising earnings estimates for this maker of analysis and processing equipment for semiconductor companies enhances its prospects of a trend reversal.

Understanding Hammer Chart and the Technique to Trade It

This is one of the popular price patterns in candlestick charting. A minor difference between the opening and closing prices forms a small candle body, and a higher difference between the low of the day and the open or close forms a long lower wick (or vertical line). The length of the lower wick being at least twice the length of the real body, the candle resembles a 'hammer.'

In simple terms, during a downtrend, with bears having absolute control, a stock usually opens lower compared to the previous day's close, and again closes lower. On the day the hammer pattern is formed, maintaining the downtrend, the stock makes a new low. However, after eventually finding support at the low of the day, some amount of buying interest emerges, pushing the stock up to close the session near or slightly above its opening price.

When it occurs at the bottom of a downtrend, this pattern signals that the bears might have lost control over the price. And, the success of bulls in stopping the price from falling further indicates a potential trend reversal.

Hammer candles can occur on any timeframe -- such as one-minute, daily, weekly -- and are utilized by both short-term as well as long-term investors.

Like every technical indicator, the hammer chart pattern has its limitations. Particularly, as the strength of a hammer depends on its placement on the chart, it should always be used in conjunction with other bullish indicators.

Here's What Makes the Trend Reversal More Likely for MKSI

An upward trend in earnings estimate revisions that MKSI has been witnessing lately can certainly be considered a bullish indicator on the fundamental side. That's because empirical research shows that trends in earnings estimate revisions are strongly correlated with near-term stock price movements.

Story Continues

Over the last 30 days, the consensus EPS estimate for the current year has increased 0.1%. What it means is that the sell-side analysts covering MKSI are majorly in agreement that the company will report better earnings than they predicted earlier.

If this is not enough, you should note that MKSI currently has a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), which means it is in the top 20% of more than 4,000 stocks that we rank based on trends in earnings estimate revisions and EPS surprises. And stocks carrying a Zacks Rank #1 or 2 usually outperform the market. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>> .

Moreover, a Zacks Rank of 2 for MKS is a more conclusive indication of a potential trend reversal, as the Zacks Rank has proven to be an excellent timing indicator that helps investors identify precisely when a company's prospects are beginning to improve.

news.Content:
It's no secret that stocks connected to the AI industry have been some of the market's top performers over the past year, but there are still a few that remain relatively under the radar. Silicon Motion Technology (NASDAQ: SIMO) is one of them. It produces NAND flash controllers, which are vital for AI infrastructure. That's the gist of what the company does, but these three key reasons for buying the stock demonstrate its long-term potential.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Silicon Motion Technology works with the leading memory providers

Silicon Motion Technology works with the largest memory-chip makers -- Micron (NASDAQ: MU), Samsung (OTC: SSNLF), SK Hynix (NASDAQ: SKHY), and Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK), as well as other fast-growing players. Rising demand for their memory products directly translates into additional revenue for Silicon Motion Technology.

Some of these customer relationships stretch across more than 20 years, which will make it more difficult for new competitors to gain market share. Silicon Motion Technology has a secure position as a key provider of NAND flash controllers, and it's also working with hyperscalers.

High growth comes at a low valuation

Silicon Motion Technology's fundamentals look promising. Its 19.6 forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio pairs nicely with revenue that more than doubled year over year in the second quarter. That growth also came with sharply rising margins. Net income jumped from $16.3 million to $136.1 million in Q2.

The company has been enjoying high sequential growth rates for its revenue and profits -- the same condition that has led to steep stock rallies for Micron and Sandisk. Silicon Motion isn't growing as quickly as those two chipmakers, but it's still growing at an accelerated rate compared to many other tech companies. Furthermore, the 20% drop the stock took over the past week was more due to macroeconomic issues than to the company's fundamentals, a point that highlights the nature of the long-term opportunity for investors.

The company has a history of crushing guidance

Investors who can tune out the macroeconomic noise and focus on management's latest guidance may see the potential upside of Silicon Motion Technology. The company guided for up to $541 million in third-quarter revenue, which would be a 20% sequential jump. That's already a good number, but Silicon Motion Technology actually has a good history of beating guidance, especially during the AI era.

Story Continues

In the first quarter, Silicon Motion Technology reported $342.1 million in net sales and anticipated up to $411 million in Q2. Its Q2 figure actually came in at $451 million, and when Silicon Motion Technology reported fourth-quarter 2025 results, it told investors to expect up to $306 million in Q1 2026.

In the current memory supercycle, memory product providers have consistently set and beat ambitious revenue targets. Micron did so in its fiscal 2026 Q4, reporting $54.23 billion in revenue compared to the $50 billion guidance figure it offered three months earlier.

Those results are very recent, and they offer good context for what Silicon Motion Technology may do when it next reports earnings on Oct. 29. If Silicon Motion Technology's largest customers are beating guidance, chances are it will do the same.

news.Title: Barclays Sees a Major Tesla and SpaceX Twist Ahead
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Speculation around a potential Tesla ( NASDAQ:TSLA ) and SpaceX ( NASDAQ:SPCX ) merger is gaining traction , with Barclays analyst Dan Levy arguing that an announcement could come before Tesla's Dec. 6 annual general meeting .

Levy's case rests less on traditional financial synergies and more on the increasing operational overlap between Elon Musk's companies.

While the industrial logic of a combination had been in question, we believe recent management comments indicate they see key benefits of a combination, Levy wrote. The true value would be in vertical integration.

The biggest driver, in Barclays' view, is Terafab .

The planned semiconductor manufacturing facility is expected to support the enormous compute needs of Tesla, SpaceX and xAI. But because the project involves multiple Musk-controlled companies, Levy argues that the current structure creates governance and approval complexity.

A merger could simplify that.

There are other obvious areas of overlap.

Tesla robotaxis could use xAI fleet-management software. Tesla vehicles could use Starlink connectivity. SpaceX data centers could rely on Tesla energy products. And Tesla's Optimus humanoid robots could use Grok for natural-language interaction.

Levy also sees a control argument.

If SpaceX acquired Tesla, using market values of roughly $2.1 trillion for SpaceX and $1.5 trillion for Tesla , Barclays estimates Musk could end up owning about 37% of the combined company with roughly 56% of the voting power .

Levy estimates Tesla shareholders could receive around 0.7 SpaceX share for each Tesla share , although the final exchange ratio would depend on any acquisition premium.

Investor Takeaway

I think the most important point is that Barclays is not saying a merger is certain .

It is arguing that the strategic logic has become more credible.

Musk himself has increasingly highlighted the overlap. On Tesla's Q2 earnings call, he said, There's more and more overlap, especially with Terafab, and later pointed to the growing collaboration between his companies.

For investors, the key things to watch are Tesla's Dec. 6 AGM, any formal board discussions, Terafab ownership structure, and whether Musk provides clearer comments on consolidation .

A merger would create one of the most unusual corporate combinations ever attempted, bringing EVs, rockets, satellites, AI, robotics, energy and semiconductor manufacturing under one umbrella.

That upside comes with equally large questions around governance, valuation and execution.

news.Title: Wall Street futures subdued as tech wobbles again; Tesla gains
news.Content:
By Tharuniyaa Lakshmi and Purvi Agarwal

Oct 16 (Reuters) - US stock index futures were muted on Friday, as technology stocks came under fresh pressure on worries about cracks building in the AI trade, though ‌a rise in Tesla shares and decline in oil prices offered support.

The electric vehicle maker rose 3% ‌in premarket trading after unveiling a redesigned Roadster, powered by rocket-style thrusters, developed in collaboration with SpaceX.

Elon Musk's rocket and space technology company gained 1.2%.

Cautionary signs ​persisted in the AI sector as Nvidia-backed CoreWeave slipped 5.2%, after Thursday's rebound, on lingering concerns about the data centre operator's debt load.

Other neocloud firms Nebius Group and Iren dipped over 2.8% each while chipmakers Micron Technology and Intel fell 2.6% and 1.4%, respectively.

Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter, that some current Anthropic investors and prospective investors in its upcoming ‌IPO are weighing a lower valuation, amid ⁠broader concerns over ballooning AI financing costs.

AI stocks have cratered this week as investors who have crowded into bets all along the AI supply chain worry that data centre operators might ⁠not turn profitable in time to repay debts, particularly with borrowing costs expected to rise.

Some of these stocks have risen sharply this year, helping push benchmarks S&P 500 and Nasdaq to record highs as recently as last week.

"When you've this incredibly bullish ​narrative ​matched with incredibly bullish outcomes but the stock declines, that is ​the sort of technical signal that tells you ‌there's too many people in the pool," said James Athey, fixed-income portfolio manager at Marlborough.

The selloff in AI stocks sparked a rotation into defensive sectors such as healthcare on Thursday, helping the main indexes close slightly higher.

The S&P 500 and Nasdaq were set to post weekly losses as an AI-led rout, mixed earnings from big banks and inflation data weighed on sentiment through the week.

The Dow, however, remained on track for a weekly advance.

At 7:51 a.m. ET, Dow ‌E-minis were down 20 points, or 0.04%, S&P 500 E-minis were ​up 3.5 points, or 0.04% and Nasdaq 100 E-minis were down 84 ​points, or 0.28%.

A nearly 1% fall in oil ​prices offered some support, though Brent crude remained above the $100-a-barrel mark. [O/R]

Hotter-than-expected consumer and producer inflation ‌reports this week have confirmed that price pressures are ​broadening out beyond energy products.

Federal ​Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh also noted that a spending surge was boosting inflation. He, however, said the US economy remained resilient and was benefiting from an AI-driven investment boom.

Story Continues

Markets increasingly expect the Fed to keep interest rates ​unchanged this month.

Among other movers, property-casualty ‌insurer Travelers dropped 4% after reporting third-quarter results. Varonis Systems climbed 2.6% as Thoma Bravo's Proofpoint agreed to ​buy the data security firm in a $6.3 billion all-cash deal.

(Reporting by Tharuniyaa Lakshmi and Purvi Agarwal in ​Bengaluru, additional reporting by Vidya Ranganathan; Editing by Joyjeet Das)

news.Title: Is Amazon Stock Poised to Gain as AI Boosts Cash Flow Prospects?
news.Content:
Amazon AMZN is steadily turning its AI push into monetizable products, which could strengthen cash flow once heavy infrastructure spending moderates. Amazon Web Services ("AWS") opened a preview of Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI in late September and, on Oct. 1, 2026, previewed the AWS Well-Architected Agent to help customers optimize cost, security and performance. This month, Bedrock also added Claude Haiku 5.5 at roughly 75% lower cost than its predecessor for most tasks. Cheaper inference and production-ready agent tools should widen enterprise adoption and deepen AWS consumption.

Fundamentals firmly back this momentum. In the second quarter of 2026, both AWS' AI business and Amazon's chips business, spanning Trainium and Graviton, crossed a $25 billion annual revenue run rate, each growing at triple-digit percentages. Anthropic and OpenAI have made multi-year, multi-gigawatt Trainium commitments, Graviton revenue commitments rose nearly 3x sequentially, and Bedrock customers spent more in the quarter than in all prior quarters combined. Such contracted demand enhances revenue visibility.

For the third quarter of 2026, Amazon expects net sales of $197-$202 billion, up 9-12% year over year, with growth nearly 400 basis points higher excluding the Prime Day timing shift. Operating income is projected at $22.5-$26.5 billion, up from $17.4 billion a year ago.

Second-quarter AWS sales jumped 37% to $42.2 billion, the fastest pace in 18 quarters, and segment operating margin widened to 39.4% from 32.9%. Trailing-12-month operating cash flow rose 33% to $161.4 billion.

However, Amazon raised its 2026 cash capital expenditure outlook to about $220 billion from $200 billion on higher memory costs, and trailing-12-month free cash flow swung to an outflow of $7.6 billion from an inflow of $18.2 billion. Management also expects capacity to fall short of demand through 2027, which could cap near-term AI revenues. Still, with a deep backlog and expanding AWS margins, Amazon appears well-placed to turn its AI spending into stronger cash generation over time.

Microsoft and Alphabet Face Similar AI Cash Flow Trade-Offs

Microsoft MSFT and Alphabet GOOGL are also balancing AI-driven growth against heavy spending. In fourth-quarter fiscal 2026, Microsoft's Azure revenues grew 43%, while operating cash flow rose 30% to $55.4 billion. However, Microsoft's capital expenditures of $41 billion reduced free cash flow by 23% to $19.6 billion, and fiscal 2027 capex is expected to be near $175 billion. Alphabet's Google Cloud revenues jumped 82% to $24.8 billion in the second quarter, with backlog reaching $514 billion. Yet Alphabet's capex doubled to $44.9 billion, turning quarterly free cash flow negative at $5.9 billion, and Alphabet raised 2026 capex guidance to up to $205 billion.

Full-quarter pricing benefits, nearly doubled U.S. Upfront commitments and a roughly $3 billion 2026 ad revenue target support monetization, while $4.7 billion of second-quarter buybacks aid per-share earnings. However, decelerating revenue growth, just 2% first-half view-hour growth and rising live-programming and technology costs temper near-term upside. Stiff competition from rivals for viewing time and a premium valuation further limit the margin of safety, making the stock suited only for patient, long-term investors.

Even though a company's earnings growth is arguably the best indicator of its financial health, nothing much happens if it cannot raise its revenues. It's almost impossible for a company to grow its earnings without growing its revenue for long periods. Therefore, knowing a company's potential revenue growth is crucial.

No investment decision can be efficient without considering a stock's valuation. Whether a stock's current price rightly reflects the intrinsic value of the underlying business and the company's growth prospects is an essential determinant of its future price performance.

Comparing the current value of a company's valuation multiples, such as its price-to-earnings (P/E), price-to-sales (P/S), and price-to-cash flow (P/CF), to its own historical values helps ascertain whether its stock is fairly valued, overvalued, or undervalued, whereas comparing the company relative to its peers on these parameters gives a good sense of how reasonable its stock price is.

Bottom Line

news.Title: 外資狂倒3025億免驚！蔡明翰曝布局法：台積電法說後「這時買爆」勝率高
news.Content:
台股今（16）日加權指數展現止跌韌性，終場收在 47,111.26 點，上漲 141.39 點，成交值為新台幣 9,359.59 億元；護國神山 台積電（2330） 於昨（15）日法說會釋出亮眼財報後，今日股價稍作拉回，收盤下跌 20 元至 2,420 元。面對昨日 外資單日狂倒 3,025.55 億元 創下台灣證券史上最大賣超紀錄，市場人心惶惶，資深分析師蔡明翰特別指出，這只是「崩盤假警報」，回檔主因是科技股漲多修正，並非產業基本面惡化。他更直言台積電法說會後短期若有震盪，一個月後勝率極高，並公開「543階梯佈局法」教投資人精準進場撿便宜。

【非產業基本面惡化！分析師揪出崩盤假警報】

針對外資單日大舉提款 3,025 億元引發的恐慌性殺盤，資深分析師蔡明翰在「財經震翰彈_蔡明翰」YouTube 頻道中深度剖析。市場將大跌歸咎於美國 CPI 通膨高於預期，以及雲端服務商 CoreWeave 公司債殖利率飆至 15% 引發資金缺口疑慮；但蔡明翰指出，通膨關鍵來自高油價，只要布蘭特原油未突破 126 美元前高，整體通膨仍在可控範圍。

至於 CoreWeave 殖利率飆升，蔡明翰表示這僅是個別公司虧損擴大的單一風險，大型雲端巨頭（如微軟）信用利差仍維持在 0.8% 至 0.9% 的健康區間，顯示風險並未蔓延至整體 AI 產業。因此，他強調這次回檔只是費半與科技股漲多後的合理修正，基本面並未變化。統計歷史前十大外資賣超紀錄更發現，外資狂賣後的 2 至 3 天往往就是波段低點，大約 2 週內即可回補跌幅。

【台積電EPS衝29元！董座魏哲家喊話：獲利無天花板】

而在台股震盪之際，台積電（2330）公布的財報宛如定海神針。第三季毛利率衝上 66.4%，EPS 突破 29 元；第四季美元營收預估季增 12% 至 16%（中值 14%），高於外資預期，全年美元營收年增率更由「超過 40%」上修至 44%。

資本支出方面，台積電今年維持 600 億至 640 億美元高檔，並預告 2026 至 2028 年未來 3 年資本支出將比前 3 年更顯著成長。董事長魏哲家更拋出重磅利多，強調「第二波 AI 需求正強勁」且「台積電獲利能力沒有天花板」，預估 2027 年 2 奈米產能將達今年的兩倍以上。

news.Title: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold MELI Stock at a P/S Valuation of 1.83X?
news.Content:
MercadoLibre, Inc. MELI currently trades at a forward 12-month price-to-sales (P/S) multiple of 1.83, marginally above the industry average of 1.81 but below its one-year median of 2.14. This positioning suggests a moderation in valuation despite the company's strong growth prospects amid lingering concerns about near-term profitability.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

Among its peers, Amazon.com, Inc. AMZN trades at a higher P/S multiple of 2.97, while Sea Limited SE trades at 1.58. MercadoLibre's valuation sits between the two, reflecting differences in business models, growth expectations and profitability profiles. With MELI trading below its historical median, a closer examination of its fundamental strengths and potential challenges can help assess the stock's prospects.

MercadoLibre's Expanding Ecosystem Supports Growth

MercadoLibre continues to benefit from the increasing adoption of e-commerce and digital financial services across Latin America. Its integrated ecosystem, encompassing Commerce, fintech, logistics and advertising, strengthens customer engagement while creating opportunities for sustainable growth. In second-quarter 2026, net revenues and financial income increased 50% year over year to $10.2 billion, reflecting strong momentum across its operations.

The company's Commerce business benefits from its expanding product assortment, improving delivery capabilities and initiatives focused on affordability and convenience. Lower free-shipping thresholds in Brazil have encouraged more frequent purchases and stronger customer retention. Meanwhile, investments in first-party offerings and cross-border trade are broadening product availability and supporting marketplace activity. Its established logistics network enhances delivery efficiency and reinforces its competitive positioning.

Mercado Pago remains a key growth catalyst, supported by rising adoption of digital payments, credit cards and other financial services. The company's ability to leverage its commerce ecosystem and transaction data supports credit underwriting and personalized financial offerings. Expanding credit-card adoption also encourages deeper customer engagement across both platforms, strengthening cross-selling opportunities.

Advertising provides another avenue for growth, with Mercado Ads benefiting from increasing merchant participation and improved monetization capabilities. AI-powered advertising tools are helping sellers optimize campaigns, while enhanced marketplace search capabilities are supporting customer conversion and engagement.

The growing number of customers using both Commerce and Mercado Pago further strengthens MercadoLibre's competitive advantage. This interconnected business model encourages higher transaction frequency, customer loyalty and greater use of financial services, providing a solid foundation for long-term growth.

Story Continues

MELI Shares Lag the Broader Market

Despite strong business momentum, MercadoLibre shares have declined 8.3% over the past year, underperforming the Zacks Retail – Wholesale sector's 0.4% rise and the S&P 500's 16.8% gain. The underperformance comes amid concerns about profitability and the near-term impact of continued strategic spending.

The stock has also lagged Amazon, whose shares have gained 19.4% over the same period. However, MELI has performed better than Sea Limited, which has declined 39.1%.

Margin Pressures and Credit Risks Challenge MercadoLibre

Despite favorable growth prospects, MercadoLibre faces challenges that could constrain near-term profitability. Continued spending on free shipping, logistics, first-party offerings and customer acquisition is weighing on margins. In second-quarter 2026, its operating margin contracted 550 basis points year over year to 6.7%, although it remained broadly stable sequentially.

In Brazil, reduced seller take rates and discounts on purchases made through PIX payments have pressured Commerce margins. Higher energy-related logistics expenses have added to cost pressures, while Mexico's acquiring business has faced margin compression from increased payment-device costs and inventory-related expenses.

Mercado Pago's rapidly expanding credit portfolio also increases exposure to potential delinquencies and credit losses amid macroeconomic uncertainties, although short-term delinquency indicators remain near historical lows. Tax-related headwinds and softer consumer demand in Mexico could affect Commerce growth. Intense competition across regional e-commerce and financial services markets may further limit pricing flexibility and profitability.

MELI's Earnings Estimate Revisions Show Mixed Trends

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for MercadoLibre's current fiscal-year earnings per share has declined from $38.29 to $38.13 over the past seven days, indicating a year-over-year decline of 3.2%. Conversely, the consensus estimate for the next fiscal year has increased from $55.03 to $55.23 during the same period, suggesting year-over-year growth of 44.9%.

The downward revision for the current year points to near-term earnings pressures amid elevated strategic spending. However, the upward revision for the following year suggests expectations of improved profitability as the company's expanding operations gain scale. These contrasting trends highlight the balance between current earnings challenges and longer-term growth potential.

What Lies Ahead for MELI Stock?

MercadoLibre's expanding Commerce footprint, growing fintech ecosystem and advertising capabilities position it well to benefit from Latin America's digital transformation. Its focus on customer engagement, logistics improvements and AI-driven efficiencies should support long-term growth. However, persistent margin pressures, credit risks and macroeconomic uncertainties remain concerns. Although the stock trades below its historical P/S median, its slight premium to the industry limits the valuation advantage. Given its strong fundamentals but mixed earnings outlook, maintaining existing positions appears reasonable while awaiting greater clarity on profitability and earnings growth.

MELI currently carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here

news.Title: Tesla stock pops after unveiling Roadster with compressed air thrusters for limited flight
news.Content:
After a two-week delay, the Tesla ( TSLA ) Roadster event went off with a massive bang — a flying one.

The wedge-shaped, cyberpunk-looking Roadster EV appeared in front of an inverted half roller coaster ramp erected at SpaceX's facility in Waco, Texas. The Roadster cruised halfway up — glued to the ramp using a vacuum fan system — then launched off the ramp upside down and performed flips in the air, using air thrusters to right itself and land on the tarmac.

Tesla stock rose as much as 5.4% during premarket trading on Friday following the Roadster event.

Then the Roadster performed a similar stunt, jumping over several Teslas (including a semi), inverted itself, and then used its thrusters to land — an automaker first. "Well, it worked," CEO Elon Musk deadpanned.

The Roadster also went 0-60 mph in less than 1 second (0.81 seconds) during a test Tesla conducted at the event. While Tesla claimed the car could hit a top speed of 230 mph, Musk boasted that the production version could target half the speed of sound, or Mach 0.5 (383 mph).

So when can you expect to get one? "We enter production in 2028," Musk said.

Tesla said the car comes in three configurations:

Performance: road-ready, seats 2, with multi-mode suction system for next-level performance on and off track;

Thrust: race-ready, seats 2, with multi-mode suction system and rear-mounted cold-gas thrusters that enable 0–60 in <1 second

Rocket: air-ready, seats 1, with multi-mode suction system, plus perimeter-mounted cold-gas thrusters for forward, upward acceleration and lateral rotational movement. So ... yes, it can fly.

Tesla said the three versions had a range exceeding 300 miles, with a top speed of up to 230 mph for the Rocket version.

Officially, in terms of performance, 0- 60 mph across the range is <1.6 seconds for Performance, <0.9 seconds for Thrust, and <0.59 seconds for Rocket.

No word yet on how the Rocket version, with its thrusters that allow short flights, would be allowed on public roads.

The event came two weeks after the initial Oct. 1 reveal date. Tesla said the reveal was pushed back due to weather conditions at the demo site, SpaceX's ( SPCX ) Rocket Development and Testing facility in Waco, Texas .

Tesla is asking prospective buyers to put down a $5,000 deposit, followed by a $45,000 wire transfer due within 10 days of the initial deposit.

Tesla has not said how much the new Roadster will cost, though it is expected to exceed $250,000.

Tesla bull Gene Munster of Deepwater Management had two big takeaways from tonight's Roadster event.

"1. It was an engineering flex with no commercial value beyond embarrassing traditional car makers.

2. Elon can't wait to bring Tesla and SpaceX together," he posted on X.com .

Story Continues

The original Roadster, released in 2008 and on sale until 2012, was Tesla's first-ever EV and used a Lotus Elise chassis.

Tesla announced its successor way back in 2017, took in reservations with those high deposits, and originally said deliveries would begin in 2020. Those initial reservation holders have been waiting for quite a long time.

During his appearance on the All-In Summit in September , Musk brought up the Tesla Roadster. "It'll be a banger. Excitement guaranteed. Success is not guaranteed, but excitement is," he added.

For Tesla fans and watchers online, the event certainly delivered - even if the some of the gravity-defying features have "no commercial value."

Pras Subramanian is Lead Auto Reporter for Yahoo Finance. You can follow him on X and on Instagram .
