news.Title: Silicon Motion Technology Corporation (SIMO) Is a Trending Stock: Facts to Know Before Betting on It
news.Content:
Silicon Motion (SIMO) is one of the stocks most watched by Zacks.com visitors lately. So, it might be a good idea to review some of the factors that might affect the near-term performance of the stock.

Over the past month, shares of this chip company have returned +3.1%, compared to the Zacks S&P 500 composite's +2.1% change. During this period, the Zacks Computer - Integrated Systems industry, which Silicon Motion falls in, has gained 3.9%. The key question now is: What could be the stock's future direction?

Although media reports or rumors about a significant change in a company's business prospects usually cause its stock to trend and lead to an immediate price change, there are always certain fundamental factors that ultimately drive the buy-and-hold decision.

Revisions to Earnings Estimates

Rather than focusing on anything else, we at Zacks prioritize evaluating the change in a company's earnings projection. This is because we believe the fair value for its stock is determined by the present value of its future stream of earnings.

Our analysis is essentially based on how sell-side analysts covering the stock are revising their earnings estimates to take the latest business trends into account. When earnings estimates for a company go up, the fair value for its stock goes up as well. And when a stock's fair value is higher than its current market price, investors tend to buy the stock, resulting in its price moving upward. Because of this, empirical studies indicate a strong correlation between trends in earnings estimate revisions and short-term stock price movements.

Silicon Motion is expected to post earnings of $3.30 per share for the current quarter, representing a year-over-year change of +230%. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus Estimate remained unchanged.

For the current fiscal year, the consensus earnings estimate of $11.16 points to a change of +214.4% from the prior year. Over the last 30 days, this estimate has remained unchanged.

For the next fiscal year, the consensus earnings estimate of $16.34 indicates a change of +46.5% from what Silicon Motion is expected to report a year ago. Over the past month, the estimate has remained unchanged.

With an impressive externally audited track record, our proprietary stock rating tool -- the Zacks Rank -- is a more conclusive indicator of a stock's near-term price performance, as it effectively harnesses the power of earnings estimate revisions. The size of the recent change in the consensus estimate, along with three other factors related to earnings estimates, has resulted in a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) for Silicon Motion.

Story Continues

The chart below shows the evolution of the company's forward 12-month consensus EPS estimate:

12 Month EPS

Revenue Growth Forecast

Even though a company's earnings growth is arguably the best indicator of its financial health, nothing much happens if it cannot raise its revenues. It's almost impossible for a company to grow its earnings without growing its revenue for long periods. Therefore, knowing a company's potential revenue growth is crucial.

For Silicon Motion, the consensus sales estimate for the current quarter of $532.81 million indicates a year-over-year change of +120.2%. For the current and next fiscal years, $1.89 billion and $2.51 billion estimates indicate +112.9% and +33.3% changes, respectively.

Last Reported Results and Surprise History

Silicon Motion reported revenues of $451 million in the last reported quarter, representing a year-over-year change of +127%. EPS of $2.43 for the same period compares with $0.69 a year ago.

Compared to the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $403.64 million, the reported revenues represent a surprise of +11.73%. The EPS surprise was +14.08%.

Over the last four quarters, Silicon Motion surpassed consensus EPS estimates three times. The company topped consensus revenue estimates each time over this period.

Valuation

No investment decision can be efficient without considering a stock's valuation. Whether a stock's current price rightly reflects the intrinsic value of the underlying business and the company's growth prospects is an essential determinant of its future price performance.

Comparing the current value of a company's valuation multiples, such as its price-to-earnings (P/E), price-to-sales (P/S), and price-to-cash flow (P/CF), to its own historical values helps ascertain whether its stock is fairly valued, overvalued, or undervalued, whereas comparing the company relative to its peers on these parameters gives a good sense of how reasonable its stock price is.

As part of the Zacks Style Scores system, the Zacks Value Style Score (which evaluates both traditional and unconventional valuation metrics) organizes stocks into five groups ranging from A to F (A is better than B; B is better than C; and so on), making it helpful in identifying whether a stock is overvalued, rightly valued, or temporarily undervalued.

Silicon Motion is graded D on this front, indicating that it is trading at a premium to its peers. Click here to see the values of some of the valuation metrics that have driven this grade.

Bottom Line

The facts discussed here and much other information on Zacks.com might help determine whether or not it's worthwhile paying attention to the market buzz about Silicon Motion. However, its Zacks Rank #3 does suggest that it may perform in line with the broader market in the near term.

news.Title: The S&P 500 Is Dangerously Concentrated in 5 Tech Giants. Are They Still Buys?
news.Content:
The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) is no longer as balanced as it has been in the past, with the index's top five positions making up nearly 30% of its holdings. This is the most concentrated the S&P 500 has ever been, and these tech five stocks -- Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA), Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL), Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) (NASDAQ: GOOG), and Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) -- will play a crucial role in the benchmark's performance, as well as in the performance of all the exchange-traded funds (ETFs), like the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (NYSEMKT: VOO), that track it.

Let's see if these five tech stocks look like buys.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Nvidia

Nvidia is the main arms dealer in the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure race, with its graphics processing units (GPUs) as the primary chips powering AI workloads. The company has a huge moat in AI model training, as most early AI code was written on its CUDA software platform for its chips. Meanwhile, over the years, it has evolved into a comprehensive AI infrastructure player that offers end-to-end solutions for specific AI tasks, including training, inference , and agentic AI.

Wherever AI infrastructure spending goes, Nvidia is sure to follow, given its market position. With spending predicted to continue to soar and the stock cheap, with under a 14.5 times forward P/E based on fiscal 2028 (ending January), Nvidia remains a buy.

Apple

Apple has one of the best business models on the planet, as its ecosystem locks in customers and keeps them there. While its hardware, like the iPhone and MacBook, is the draw, it generates a lot of high-margin service revenue from selling cloud storage, commissions on apps and subscriptions, getting a small cut on transactions through Apple Pay, and through its revenue-sharing deal with Alphabet to allow Google to be the default search engine on its devices.

At 35 times forward P/E, the stock is a bit pricey, which could limit upside, but investors are getting a great compounding company that should perform well over the long term.

Microsoft

Microsoft is a leading cloud computing and enterprise productivity software-as-a-service (SaaS) company that also owns 27% of ChatGPT maker OpenAI. Its Azure cloud unit has shown consistent, rapid growth of more than 30% each quarter over the past three years, while it has a huge computing backlog of $678 billion anchored by commitments from OpenAI.

Story Continues

At the same time, given how entrenched its software is in the enterprise space, it's also becoming an AI software winner. It's seeing strong adoption of its AI assistant, Copilot, with paid users nearly doubling sequentially last quarter to 30 million seats. With the company firing on all cylinders, the stock looks reasonably valued, trading at 27 times fiscal 2027 analyst estimates (ending in June 2027) and just above 22.5 times fiscal 2028 consensus estimates.

Alphabet

While best known for Google Search, Alphabet is the most complete AI name, having both its own top-tier AI model and chips. Its chips business is a real differentiator. It allows Alphabet to train and run inference for its AI models more cheaply than competitors do, while its cloud unit achieves a one-year payback on its AI chip and networking investments when it uses its own chips. On top of that, it has started letting partner Broadcom sell directly to Anthropic, which has opened up another high-margin revenue stream for it.

Trading at a forward P/E of 23 times 2027 analyst estimates, the stock looks attractively valued given its growth and position in the market. I'd buy the stock.

Amazon

Amazon is the market share leader in both cloud computing and e-commerce. Its cloud business is accelerating, and the company thinks this could eventually become a $1 trillion revenue business. It's investing aggressively and has a huge backlog, with backing from Anthropic and OpenAI. It also has an emerging chip business.

On the e-commerce side, the company has been seeing strong operating leverage stemming from its investments in robots, automation, and AI. The company does not get nearly the credit it deserves in this area, in my view, while it's also become one of the world's leading digital ad platforms.

At a forward P/E of 25 times based on 2027 estimates, Amazon is trading at a historically attractive valuation, making it a buy.

The S&P 500 and VOO

While the S&P 500 and ETFs like VOO are now highly concentrated, I still see attractive valuations and strong upside potential in four of the index's top five stocks. Apple is the lone exception; I see it as a little pricey, but it is still one of the world's great compounding businesses, and the stock will work over time.

As such, I wouldn't be too worried about the S&P 500's high concentration levels at this point and would continue to be a buyer of VOO, as well.

news.Content: If Amazon's (AMZN) chips unit were a standalone company selling to outside buyers, CEO Andy Jassy estimates it would bring in about $50 billion a year. He believes that would rank it among the three largest data center chip businesses in the world. That context helps explain why Amazon is reportedly willing to spend around $7 billion on Decart, an Israeli AI startup, according to The Wall Street Journal . No deal has been finalized yet. Trainium's pitch is simple. It offers more AI performance for every dollar spent. Jassy says Trainium2 delivers about 30% more performance per dollar than ...
news.AI_Summary:

• Decart's optimization software could help customers transition AI models to Amazon's Trainium chips, reducing switching costs from Nvidia (NVDA).

news.Title: 績效前20%投資人買什麼基金？ 「鉅亨買基金」揭曉：近9成集中台股基金
news.Content:
投資市場波動不斷，績效表現相對突出的投資人，究竟都買哪些基金？「鉅亨買基金」今(14)日表示，觀察客戶近3年報酬表現，針對報酬率排名前20%的客群進行持倉分析，發現這群投資人的股票型基金占比高達96.6%，台股及台灣中小型股票基金合計占這群客戶總基金資產88.1%，約為其他客群的2.7倍，顯示台股基金為這群客戶配置的主力。

除了股票型基金比重明顯偏高，績效前20%客群在基金類型與投資方式上，也呈現出與其他客群不同的特色。鉅亨買基金統計數據顯示，這群投資人持有累積型基金的比重達96.4%，明顯高於其他客群的62.5%；境內基金占比也達95%，相較其他客群的48.1%高出不少，反映其基金配置更集中於國內市場，且累積型基金是主要選擇之一。

鉅亨買基金投資研究部主管羅瑤庭表示，從這次持倉分析可以觀察到，績效前段客群的配置相對集中，尤其對台股基金有較高比重。這項結果呈現的是近三年報酬表現排名前20%客群的持倉特徵，有助於了解不同投資人之間的配置差異，但不能據此認定集中投資台股就是績效較佳的原因，也不代表採取相同策略就能複製過去的報酬表現，進一步比較其他資產配置，績效前20%客群配置於多重資產與債券型基金的比重合計僅3.3%，遠低於其他客群的31.6%，兩者差異相當明顯。

但羅瑤庭指出，股票型基金比重較高，代表投資組合的表現更容易受到股市行情影響；當市場震盪或回檔時，集中配置也可能放大資產波動，因此選擇基金時仍應回到自身的投資目標、資金用途與投資期限，並衡量可承受的風險，而非只看過去績效排名。

累積型基金也是績效前20%客群的配置特色之一。羅瑤庭表示，累積型基金通常將收益留在基金內持續運作，對著眼長期資產累積的投資人而言，是可以評估的投資方式；但是否適合，仍須視個人資金需求與投資目標而定，若有定期現金流需求或對資產波動較為敏感，也應一併考量不同基金類型的特性，而非單純跟隨市場上的熱門選擇。

「鉅亨買基金」也提醒，績效前段客群的持倉可作為觀察市場投資行為的參考，但不宜直接複製為個人投資組合，投資人應先確認自身的投資目標、資金需求與風險承受能力，再規劃合適的資產配置，並定期檢視投資組合。過去績效不代表未來表現，基金投資具有風險，投資前應審慎評估。

news.AI_Summary:

news.Title: 台積法說前外資賣超200億元呈連6賣 倒貨南亞科2.3萬張、京元電2.2萬張
news.Content:

投信主要買超台塑化 1.4萬張、遠東新 1.2萬張、華新 6556張，也買超台泥 5637張、南亞 4541張、台塑 4315張，並敲進金像電 3725張、元大高股息 3030張、大成鋼 1354張，以及買入0050共1350張。

投信主要調節兆豐金 6743張、聯電 5909張、和碩 2728張，也賣超緯穎 1663張、玉山金 1341張、台新新光金 1212張，並賣出華邦電 1168張、文曄 879張、台灣高鐵 848張，以及賣超強茂 799張。

news.Title: 台股收紅外資賣壓收斂　新台幣由貶翻升終止連4黑
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘姿羽台北14日電）台灣昨天經歷股匯雙殺，今天甩開陰霾，台股收紅，新台幣兌美元也上演戲劇性反轉，盤中一度重貶逾1.4角、跌破32.2元，午後跌幅逐步收斂，尾盤更是由貶翻升，收盤收32.073元，升1.2分，終止連4黑，台北及元太外匯市場總成交金額33.835億美元。

昨天受到中東戰火延燒、AI疑慮升溫、晶片股賣壓沉重等利空夾殺，台灣股匯市慘遭血洗。外資狂砍台股新台幣1653.42億元，創下外資單日賣超金額第3大，熱錢瘋狂匯出，導致新台幣貶勢難止，盤中狂殺逾3角，當日台北及元太外匯市場總成交金額爆出71.145億美元的史上最大量。

儘管市場對AI疑慮猶存，美股4大指數全收黑，台指期夜盤上揚，提振投資人信心。台股今天盤中震盪670點，一度收復49000點關卡，達到49059.12點，終場漲勢收斂，收在48625.83點，上漲284.52點。

外資依舊站在空方，今天續砍台股200.37億元，呈現連6賣，累計提款台股逾3300億元，但賣超金額已大幅收斂。

相較於台股回穩，新台幣兌美元今天早盤仍承受貶值壓力，一早以32.1元開出後，迅速貶至32.2元價位，盤中最低32.228元，不過午後外資反手匯入，加上出口商積極拋匯，跌幅迅速收斂，央行也於尾盤調節，匯價再度上演「神龍擺尾」，收在32.073元，終止連4黑。

外匯交易員指出，一早匯市延續昨天的貶值走勢，新台幣貶至32.2元價位，但主要反映外資先前賣超台股後的資金匯出需求，並非資金持續撤離，市場氛圍已逐漸回穩。尤其新台幣貶破32.2元後，出口商拋匯意願明顯升高，帶動市場供需趨於平衡；成交金額也從昨天的逾70億美元縮減至30多億美元，交易逐漸回歸常態。

外匯交易員指出，午後隨台股收紅，部分外資甚至反手匯入，與出口商站在同一陣線，貶幅因此逐步收斂，加上央行調節，終場得以小升作收。

新台幣匯率回穩，不過美國今晚將公布9月消費者物價指數（CPI），牽動市場對美國聯準會的升息預期，週四則有台積電法說登場。外匯交易員表示，投資人屏息以待本週兩件關鍵大事，尤其新台幣匯率升貶多由外資主宰，如果台積電法說釋出正面訊號，台股得以重整旗鼓、攻破5萬點，不只外資匯出壓力減輕，甚至可望回頭回補資金，支撐新台幣走勢。（編輯：楊蘭軒）1151014

news.Title: As Big Tech Designs Its Own AI Chips, the Companies Behind the Scenes Win
news.Content: For years, AI data centers have almost exclusively relied on GPUs for all AI processing and learning. But as tech companies have deployed more advanced models and AI agents become prolific, custom processors have become increasingly important. That's because custom processors can be fine-tuned to run specific AI models for agents faster and more efficiently than general GPU processors for some tasks. And some of the biggest winners in this space are custom chip designers Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) and Marvell Technology ...
news.AI_Summary:
• The increasing demand for custom AI processors, designed for efficiency and speed in specific AI models, is benefiting companies beyond GPU manufacturers.
• Alphabet's Google Cloud revenue grew 82% to $24.8 billion in Q2, driven partly by custom TPUs and a multiyear deal with Broadcom for custom processors through 2031.
• Marvell Technology is designing custom chips for Amazon's Trainium and Microsoft's Maia AI processors, with Microsoft Azure surpassing $100 billion in annual revenue.
• Nvidia invested $2 billion in Marvell, highlighting the intertwined nature of the AI processor market, though custom processors may eventually erode Nvidia's market share.
• Custom processors are projected to grow 45% this year, significantly outpacing GPU growth of 16%, while AMD secured a $60 billion deal with Meta.
news.Keywords: custom AI chips, processor design, AI infrastructure, cloud computing, semiconductor market, supply chain

news.Title: 台塑四寶集體強攻還能追嗎？施羅德：短線健康輪動
news.Content:
台塑四寶14日集體強攻，南亞盤中攻上350.5元漲停價創歷史新高，台塑、台化以88.9元、85.5元攻上漲停，台塑化早盤最高漲至129元，漲幅達8.4％，塑膠類股指數大漲9.6％，吸引市場資金轉進傳統產業股；施羅德投信台股投資團隊主管游秋華表示，塑化、面板類股近日轉強，這是屬於短線健康輪動，不同族群輪漲，對台股指數未來漲勢是正面的訊息。

台塑四寶股價漲勢凌厲，投資人關心「還能追嗎？」游秋華未正面回應，但她認為，台塑集團旗下部分子公司與 AI供應鏈相關，帶動集團整體獲利，股價有一定的支撐。

護國神山台積電今最高來到2535元，游秋華進一步指出，台積電漲多，其他便宜類股也應該要有輪動，短期輪動會讓指數更健康；不僅台股塑化類股上漲，游秋華表示，美國近來類股輪動也有同樣趨勢，近2個月上漲多是防禦型的類股。

施羅德正式將主動式ETF版圖拓展至台灣市場，14日宣布推出(00419A) 施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF ，是施羅德繼澳洲、美國及歐洲既有的主動式ETF管理經驗之後的台灣首秀，台灣推出主動式E TF亦是施羅德在亞洲首檔，為投資人提供一檔聚焦於台灣上市AI及科技價值鏈企業的投資商品。

(00419A)主動施羅德AI台股聚焦投資受惠於AI發展趨勢的台灣企業，掌握台灣AI生態系長期成長機會。投資範圍涵蓋半導體、光通訊、零組件、基礎建設及重電等AI應用領域企業，完整布局AI產業鏈不同發展環節。

news.Title: 當近半數個股默默下跌20% 專家如何評估美股目前榮景？
news.Content:
在標普500指數持續強勁的背後，金融媒體《The Motley Fool》分析師Steven Porrello警告，當前股票市場表面看似堅不可摧，實則已在暗處響起罕見的歷史警訊。

他強調，這場延續4年的多頭行情過去未曾被關稅、戰爭或升息所打斷，但市場內部的脆弱性與極端的估值水準，正預示著未來可能面臨的動盪。

近半數成分股已陷入熊市

據《MarketWatch》報導，標普500指數已有高達 44% 的成分股，目前處於熊市領域，即股價較其 52 周高點下跌了至少 20%。

其中，約 24% 的股票自高點下跌至少 30%；8% 的股票跌幅高達 40% 以上；甚至有 3% 的成分股暴跌了 50%。

Porrello指出，這意味著整體指數強勁的績效表現，實際上掩蓋了近半數企業個股運營與股價的困境，市場漲勢僅由少數大型權值股所支撐帶動。

CAPE 比率突破40

除了個股分化的隱憂，市場估值過高更是Porrello的核心警訊。報導指出，「席勒周期調整本益比」(Shiller P/E ratio，又稱 CAPE 比率)已連續至少5個月發出異常訊號。CAPE 比率是用來評估股票相對於長期盈利是昂貴還是便宜的估值工具，在過去 155 年的歷史中，其平均值約為 18。

如今，標普500指數的 CAPE 比率已跨越 40 大關，這是美股歷史上第二次出現如此極端的估值水準。

Porrello特別提醒，上一次 CAPE 比率突破 40 是在 1999 年網路泡沫時期，隨後市場便迎來了極具破壞性的熊市。雖然 CAPE 比率並非直接預測股市崩盤的精準工具，但歷史經驗清楚表明：當股票估值達到異常高昂的水準時，通常無法長期維持。

歷史經驗與長期投資策略

儘管罕見警訊預示著潛在風險，Porrello仍為投資人提供了理性的應對思考。他引述嘉信理財(Charles Schwab)的歷史數據指出，自 1990 年以來，標普500指數至少經歷了 17 次回檔與熊市。雖然部分熊市(如網路泡沫)抹去了指數近一半的價值，但每一次熊市與修正最終都走向結束，這是股市投資的正常現象。

Porrello總結稱，試圖準確預測股市何時下跌或反彈是一場注定失敗的遊戲。面對 CAPE 比率所提示的熊市威脅，投資人最明智的策略是保持長期視角，選擇優質企業並跨越景氣循環長期持有，以安然度過市場的起伏波動。

news.Title: 神山尾盤遭提款200億台股仍漲284點！南亞狂飆奪吸金王 國巨領被動元件搶鋒頭｜Yahoo財經掃描

👥面板雙虎：

面板雙虎轉型題材發威，股價與人氣同步升溫！友達(2409)、群創(3481)受玻璃基板、Micro LED及面板級扇出型封裝（FOPLP）等題材帶動，成為市場關注焦點。Yahoo財經試算，若以去年10月低點買進、今年波段高點計算，同樣投入1萬元，友達最高可增值至約3.27萬元，群創更達約4.9萬元，兩者相差約1.63萬元。而股東人數也掀起「面板狂潮」...... 點我看更多

台灣方面，主計總處將公布8月薪資統計，勞動部公布減班休息統計，行政院會也將召開，薪資成長、勞動市場與政策動向值得關注；上市金控9月及前三季獲利將全數揭曉，另有國銀8月中小企業放款、外幣存放款統計，以及金管會8月信用卡與電子支付資訊、國銀9月信用卡資訊。信義區周年慶開打，SHOPLINE也將舉行AI轉型新策略說明會；個股焦點以台積電(2330)法說會為主，市場將聚焦營運展望、AI需求與先進製程布局，毅嘉(2402)也將舉行法說會，華建(2530)、鼎炫-KY(8499)則召開股東會。此外，強盛新(1463)、長科*(6548)將除息，精華生醫(7806)將轉上櫃。

news.Title: 〈第四季台股展望〉資深股民信心爆棚！72.4% 樂觀看多台股、近九成押寶AI 與半導體
news.Content:
隨著第四季行情正式拉開序幕，台股投資人的心態備受市場關注。根據鉅亨與華南永昌證券最新出爐的「2026年第四季台股展望問卷調查」顯示，在 582 份有效樣本中，高達 72.4% 的受訪者對第四季台股整體抱持樂觀態度（其中 50.3% 偏多看待、22.1% 非常樂觀），僅有 3.8% 看空。整體投資信心平均分數高達 4.05 分（滿分 5 分），近八成（78.8%）的投資人給出 4 至 5 分的高分，顯示市場多頭氣氛濃厚。

核心動能：AI 與半導體需求續居主流

本次調查中最顯著的特徵在於市場共識高度集中。在支撐第四季上漲的主要因素中，高達 88.4% 的受訪者將票投給「AI 及半導體需求持續成長」，穩居各項因素之首；其次則是占比 63.4% 的「股市年底作帳行情」，以及「外資回流台股」（40.2%）與「上市櫃公司獲利改善」（38.2%）。

在產業與主題偏好上，AI 供應鏈同樣全面霸榜。最看好的前三大產業依序為半導體（76.2%）、AI 伺服器（62.5%）以及 PCB／載板（34.9%），後續如先進封裝、散熱、機器人及自動化等題材也獲得高度青睞。此外，多達 68.7% 的受訪者認為「AI 需求持續成長」是帶動第四季成長的最主要主題，反映出台股投資人對科技主軸的強烈信仰。

潛在隱憂：通膨再升溫與地緣政治成主要雜音

儘管多頭聲勢浩大，但居高思危的意識依然存在。在探討第四季最大的風險時，受訪者的憂慮主要集中在外部總體經濟與國際局勢：有 64.6% 的人擔心「通膨再度升溫」，61.3% 擔憂「地緣政治衝突」，其次則為「美國降息不如預期」（42.6%）。

值得注意的是，在科技股驚驚漲之際，有 40.9% 的受訪者坦言擔憂「美國科技股或 AI 類股估值過高」，另有 28.9% 擔心「融資餘額過高、籌碼凌亂」。這顯示出市場雖樂觀，但部分資金對於高檔震盪與評價面過熱仍存有一定戒心。

投資人結構與風險偏好：防禦型資產遭冷落

從受訪者輪廓來看，本次填答者以資深族群為主，50 歲以上占 57.2%，投資年資超過 10 年者更高達 57.7%，多數採自行選股（76.4%）或定期定額（50.3%）。交叉分析顯示，年資 1 至 3 年的較資淺投資人相對保守，信心指數（3.91 分）與 AI 押注比例較低；而年資較深的投資人則展現出較高的風險偏好。

有趣的是，在資金一面倒向科技成長股的同時，傳統的防禦型資產如高股息股、金融股及防禦型股票的支持度全面在 10% 以下，合計不到一成。這反映出第四季的盤勢結構中，市場主導權仍緊緊掌握在攻擊型的科技與 AI 族群手中。

整體而言，法人分析指出，第四季在基本面有 AI 長線需求撐腰、年底作帳行情即將啟動的雙重加持下，大盤具備向上攻堅的動能；然而面對高檔融資與評價過高的雜音，投資人在樂觀追價的同時，仍須密切關注總經數據與國際地緣政治的變化，靈活調配資產配置。

news.Title: 外資賣超200億！ 重砍台積電6752張 大買「這族群」網驚呆
news.Content:
台股今（14）日震盪走高，盤中一度大漲逾441點，但尾盤受到台積電賣壓影響，漲幅明顯收斂，終場指數上漲284點，收在48,625點，漲幅0.59%，成交量達9,286億元。三大法人合計賣超153.96億元，其中外資及陸資賣超200.37億元。

值得注意的是，台積電即將舉行法說會，今（14）日尾盤卻突然遭遇大筆賣單。最後5分鐘撮合時，台積電慘遭7,999張賣單摜壓，以收盤價2,490元估算，金額接近200億元，股價也瞬間從2,505元下挫15元，終場以平盤作收。外資今日同步賣超台積電6,752張，市場關注法說會前法人籌碼動向。

觀察外資買超個股，傳產股成為主要布局方向。中鋼（2002）以買超7萬7,005張居冠，台塑（1301）買超5萬3,390張排名第二，台玻（1802）也獲買超4萬6,522張，位居第三，顯示外資資金明顯流向原物料及傳產族群。其餘買超標的包括復華富時不動產（00712）買超2萬9,664張、華新（1605）買超2萬8,387張、台化（1326）買超2萬7,479張、中石化（1314）買超2萬2,491張，以及元大金（2885）買超2萬1,535張。

此外，陽明（2609）獲外資買超1萬6,326張，仁寶（2324）買超1萬6,300張。整體來看，外資買超前十名中，鋼鐵、塑化、玻璃及航運等傳產股占據多個席次，與市場聚焦AI及半導體族群的投資方向形成對比。

賣超方面，記憶體族群南亞科（2408）遭外資賣超2萬2,967張，排名第一；半導體測試廠京元電子（2449）遭賣超2萬2,655張，排名第二，顯示外資同步調節記憶體及半導體相關個股。台塑化（6505）遭外資賣超1萬9,974張，聯電（2303）賣超1萬6,001張，主動中信台灣收益（00406A）則遭賣超1萬2,770張。金融股方面，臺企銀（2834）遭賣超9,624張，台新新光金（2887）賣超8,324張，永豐金（2890）賣超7,598張。

另外，台亞（2340）遭外資賣超7,655張，元大台灣50（0050）賣超6,925張，台積電（2330）也遭賣超6,752張。台積電法說會前夕出現尾盤大單賣壓，加上外資持續調節部分半導體及記憶體個股，成為市場關注焦點。

外資買賣超名單曝光後，也引發PTT股市板網友討論。針對外資大舉買進中鋼、台塑、台玻等傳產股，有網友直呼「滿滿傳產」，也有人留言「錢進傳產」，認為資金流向值得觀察。

不過，外資調節南亞科與京元電，也讓不少股民感到無奈。有網友針對南亞科遭賣超表示疑惑，也有人對京元電連續出現在賣超名單表達不滿。另有網友注意到台塑化遭大幅賣超，認為傳產股內部也存在不同的籌碼方向。

• The company reported $364 billion in net sales for the first three quarters of fiscal 2026, a 16% increase year-over-year.
• Analysts forecast net sales growth to slow to 11% in fiscal 2027 from an estimated 15% for the current fiscal year, with 8% growth expected for the holiday quarter.

news.Title: 〈陸股盤後〉中國9月出口額激增36.3% 市場不領情 三大指數走低
news.Content:
中國A股三大指數周三（14日）收盤走低，海關總署公布的數據顯示，9月出口總額為4,471.8億美元，較一年前增長36.3%，但市場並未領情。

上證指數周三收報3,767.23點，跌0.88%。深證成指收報12,110.59點，跌1.97%。創業板指收報2,866.76點，跌3.10%。

今年1～9月，中國出口總額為3.3707兆美元，較去年同期增長21.3%；進口總額為2.4325兆美元，增加27.5%，貿易順差為9,381.1億美元。

海關總署副署長王軍14日在國新辦記者會上表示，前三季外貿增速是近5年同期最快，季度和月度增速也總體呈現加快態勢。

王軍說，橫向看，最新國際數據顯示，這樣的貿易增速在主要經濟體中位居前列，中國繼續穩居全球貨物貿易第一大國地位。

王軍提到，前三季中國外貿有效應對外部衝擊，保持良好發展勢頭。儘管當前國際形勢變亂交織、各種風險挑戰層出不窮，但中國外貿發展的動力和活力增強、韌性彰顯。第四季進出口持續增長有基礎、有支撐。

news.Title: 台股衝鋒帶旺商場 環球購物估周年慶業績年增達雙位數
news.Content:
台股上攻 5 萬點，多頭行情間接刺激民間消費！為迎戰年度最大檔期周年慶，冠德(2520-TW)轉投資環球購物中心Global Mall今(14)日宣布全台8店攜手20大品牌推出逾70%的獨家商品活動，涵蓋3C家電、秋冬服飾、化妝品等業種，預計周年慶期間業績年增達雙位數。

而Global Mall板橋車站集結橫跨運動休閒、流行服飾、美妝保養、生活用品和餐飲等多元品類。

環球購物進一步指出，車站型據點首度於周年慶期間集結館內人氣甜點、伴手禮和特色餐飲品牌，推出獨家限定商品，其中， Global Mall南港車站和板橋車站再加碼10月22日至11月4日會員回饋。

對於電商持續成長，Global Mall環球Online也同步打出「Online會員獨家價」、「挑戰市場最低價」、「隨身美學不可少」和「生活日用最實惠」四大優惠主題，搶啖3C家電、美妝保養、居家生活及寵物用品商機。

環球Online 10月22日至 11月16日當日單筆滿3,000元送300元，於第一波10月22日至11月4日推出刷中信Global Mall聯名卡單筆滿3,000元再贈300元，首5日再加碼滿10,000元加贈500元，而11月5日至16日第二波接續登場，並規劃首四日3C家電超品日及雙11早鳥必買清單，再享刷中信Global Mall聯名卡當日單筆2000送100或單筆滿5000送400(2擇1)。

news.Title: 外資台股續賣，新台幣重貶後驚險翻升1.2分，以32.073元日高作收
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】台北外匯市場週三新台幣兌美元匯價大半場維持貶勢，午間一度下探32.228元、重貶1.43角或0.45%，尾盤獲買盤進場輸血翻升，以升值1.2分的日高價作收，新台幣繼週二爆量收挫後，週三走勢極具戲劇性。週二油價與全球債市殖利率走低，推動美元指數從三個月高點回落，加上台股反彈、日韓元升值，一定程度給予台幣支撐。新台幣兌美元匯率週三以32.073元作收，與前一交易日比較，台幣匯率升值1.2分。銀行間新台幣兌美元最高成交價為32.073元，最低成交價為32.228元，成交量仍達22億2,400萬美元。

外資週二大舉賣超台股1,653億元台幣後，市場關注外資後續的匯出力道。週三台股上揚，加權指數收漲0.59%，但是外資持續賣超上市股票200.3億元，累計近六個交易日賣超約3,300億元。

華僑銀行策略分析師Christopher Wong等人在報告中指稱，對台幣短期走勢略偏審慎，尤其是一旦外資持續流出台股且美債殖利率維持高檔。

news.Title: 鉅亨買基金：前20%投資高手 近九成資產重壓台股
news.Content:
投資市場波動不斷，績效表現相對突出的投資人，究竟都買哪些基金？「鉅亨買基金」觀察客戶近三年報酬表現，針對報酬率排名前20%的客群進行持倉分析，發現這群投資人的股票型基金占比高達96.6%，其中台灣股票及台灣中小型股票基金合計占這群客戶總基金資產88.1%，約為其他客群的2.7倍，顯示台股基金是這群客戶配置的主力。

除了股票型基金比重明顯偏高，績效前20%客群在基金類型與投資方式上，也呈現出與其他客群不同的特色。「鉅亨買基金」統計數據顯示，這群投資人持有累積型基金的比重達96.4%，明顯高於其他客群的62.5%；境內基金占比也達95.0%，相較其他客群的48.1%高出不少，反映其基金配置更集中於國內市場，且累積型基金是主要選擇之一。

「鉅亨買基金」投資研究部主管羅瑤庭表示，從這次持倉分析可以觀察到，績效前段客群的配置相對集中，尤其對台股基金有較高比重。這項結果呈現的是近三年報酬表現排名前20%客群的持倉特徵，有助於了解不同投資人之間的配置差異，但不能據此認定集中投資台股就是績效較佳的原因，也不代表採取相同策略就能複製過去的報酬表現。

進一步比較其他資產配置，績效前20%客群配置於多重資產與債券型基金的比重合計僅3.3%，遠低於其他客群的31.6%，兩者差異相當明顯。不過，羅瑤庭指出，股票型基金比重較高，代表投資組合的表現更容易受到股市行情影響；當市場震盪或回檔時，集中配置也可能放大資產波動。因此，選擇基金時仍應回到自身的投資目標、資金用途與投資期限，並衡量可承受的風險，而非只看過去績效排名。

累積型基金也是績效前20%客群的配置特色之一。羅瑤庭表示，累積型基金通常將收益留在基金內持續運作，對著眼長期資產累積的投資人而言，是可以評估的投資方式；但是否適合，仍須視個人資金需求與投資目標而定。若有定期現金流需求，或對資產波動較為敏感，也應一併考量不同基金類型的特性，而非單純跟隨市場上的熱門選擇。

「鉅亨買基金」提醒，績效前段客群的持倉可作為觀察市場投資行為的參考，但不宜直接複製為個人投資組合。投資人應先確認自身的投資目標、資金需求與風險承受能力，再規劃合適的資產配置，並定期檢視投資組合。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 知名空頭羅森柏格：美股泡沫與失衡 已達他40年職業生涯之最
news.Content:
總部位於多倫多的 Rosenberg Research & Associates Inc. 創辦人羅森柏格(David Rosenberg)表示，他40年的職業生涯中，從未見過美國股市在估值、槓桿率和投資者部位達到如此極端的水準，呈現出極高的泡沫風險與失衡現象。

羅森柏格強調，與網路泡沫時期相比，目前的牛市對人工智慧(AI)發展的依賴程度有過之而無不及。他認為美國是這波科技熱潮的震央，而投資人正付出過高代價，因此他在個人的資產配置中已轉向購買美國公債與海外股票。

除了市場對 AI 的過度依賴外，羅森柏格警告美國基礎經濟存在脆弱性，特別是消費者日益仰賴股市上漲來支撐日常生活消費。

他對下一波熊市可能引發的社會衝擊表達深切擔憂，並指出提早退休、靠投資組合過活的勞工未來恐面臨嚴峻抉擇，甚至面臨重返職場尋求收銀員工作卻已被機器人取代的困境。

羅森柏格向來以看空立場聞名，曾任美林證券北美首席經濟學家，因在 2008 年金融危機前成功預警美國房地產泡沫而聲名大噪，在 Gluskin Sheff 任職十餘年後，他離職創辦了自己的研究公司。

news.Title: 台股收漲284點！ 網見三法法人操作驚：內資軋外資
news.Content:
台股今（14）日震盪後走高，指數終場上漲284.52點，漲幅0.59%，收在48,625.83點，成交量達9,286億元。三大法人合計賣超153.96億元。

根據證交所公布資料，三大法人今日合計賣超153.96億元。其中，外資及陸資賣超200.37億元，自營商自行買賣賣超25.09億元，自營商避險賣超89.61億元；投信則大舉買超161.11億元，成為三大法人中唯一站在買方的法人。

觀察投信買超個股，台塑化（6505）以買超1萬4,106張居冠，遠東新（1402）買超1萬2,043張排名第二，華新（1605）買超6,556張、台泥（1101）買超5,637張，南亞（1303）買超4,541張、台塑（1301）買超4,315張，顯示投信資金明顯布局塑化與傳產族群。電子股方面，金像電（2368）獲投信買超3,725張；ETF則有元大高股息（0056）買超3,030張、元大台灣50（0050）買超1,350張。此外，大成鋼（2027）也獲買超1,354張。

在投信賣超方面，兆豐金（2886）以賣超6,743張居冠，聯電（2303）賣超5,909張排名第二，和碩（4938）賣超2,728張，緯穎（6669）賣超1,663張。金融股部分，玉山金（2884）遭賣超1,341張，台新新光金（2887）賣超1,212張；此外，華邦電（2344）賣超1,168張、文曄（3036）賣超879張、台灣高鐵（2633）賣超848張，強茂（2481）則賣超799張。

整體來看，投信今日買超集中在台塑化、遠東新等傳產股，賣超則涵蓋金融、半導體及電子通路族群，資金調整方向相當明顯。

三大法人買賣超數據公布後，也引發PTT股板熱烈討論。面對外資持續賣超、台股卻逆勢收漲的情況，不少網友好奇買盤究竟來自何方，留言直呼、「到底誰在買啦」，也有人笑稱「大哥回來了」、「投信我大哥」。有網友認為，投信大舉買超，對盤勢形成一定支撐，留言表示「大哥沒有輸」，甚至有人直言「內資軋外資的一天」，認為本土資金正在與外資形成對作。

不過，也有網友對後續走勢抱持保留態度，認為外資持續賣超仍是隱憂，提醒市場不能只看單日反彈就認定賣壓已經結束。另有網友質疑，指數上漲也可能讓外資有機會逢高調節，認為仍須觀察後續外資動向。

news.Title: 《台股盤後》量縮收漲284點 10日線及49K得而復失
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-14 15:46:56 新聞中心 發佈

台股今(14)日盤初呈現開高走高，在鴻海、國巨*、日月光投控走揚，加上塑膠、玻璃陶瓷、電器電纜等傳產族群強漲支撐下，加權指數盤中一度漲逾700點，重返4萬9000點關卡，不過因緯穎、聯發科、台光電與南亞科等走弱，且台積電尾盤拉回至平盤，壓抑漲勢，加權指數今終場收在48625.83點，上漲284.52點或0.59%，49K與10日線得而復失，成交量縮減至9286.24億元。

花旗(Citigroup)等美國大型銀行公布的財報好壞參半，再加上半導體設備、記憶體類股挫跌，拖累那斯達克指數、費城半導體指數13日走軟。亞洲股市方面，因日經225指數昨日重挫逾1,200點，吸引低接買盤湧入，AI、半導體相關股走揚，也帶動日經指數14日反彈，不過因獲利了結而翻黑，日經225指數終場下跌0.049%；韓國股市今日開高走低，KOSPI指數盤中一度大漲逾2%，隨賣壓出籠，KOSPI終場翻黑、下跌0.44%。

台股今日震盪走高，加權指數終場收在48625.83點，上漲284.52點。盤面資金明顯轉向傳產族群，推升大盤穩步墊高，市場買氣維持活絡，顯示投資人對後市仍偏向審慎樂觀。電子族群今日漲跌互見，台積電盤中最高來到2535元，不過尾盤拉回至平盤2490元；國巨*漲逾4%，創意、鴻海、健策、奇鋐、日月光投控、台達電等收紅，大立光跌逾5%，鴻勁、緯穎、南亞科都收黑，聯發科下跌1.1%。

觀察今日類股表現，塑膠類股最為強勢，漲幅達9.27%，成為盤面領漲焦點，台塑四寶今日漲勢強勁，其中台化、台塑都亮燈漲停，南亞也大漲9.4%。玻璃陶瓷類股上漲7.8%，走勢同樣亮眼，台玻勁揚逾8%。電器電纜類股漲幅3.66%，也擠進今日表現最佳前三名。而居家生活、光電及半導體族群今日表現則相對弱勢。從類股輪動來看，資金並非僅集中於電子權值股，而是擴散至多個傳產族群，帶動整體市場人氣回溫。整體而言，台股今日在傳產股帶動下收紅，後續仍須觀察資金輪動延續性，以及成交量能否維持高檔水準，作為大盤續強的重要依據。

三大法人動向方面，今日三大法人總計賣超153.96億元；其中，外資及陸資(不含外資自營商)賣超200.37億元，投信買超161.11億元，自營商賣超114.7億元。

news.Title: 【Follow法人】外資續賣超200億元！再提款台積電168億元 南亞科台塑化也中箭
news.Content:
（下午4點37分更新外資買賣超個股）

三大法人今（14）日合計賣超153.97億元，其中外資繼昨日創下史上第三大單日賣超紀錄後，今日再提款200.37億元。南亞科（2408）遭賣超逾2萬張居冠，台塑化（6505）也成為提款標的；台積電（2330）則遭調節6752張，以收盤價估算約168億元。分析師認為，外資今日偏向預防性避險，擔心稍晚公布的美國9月消費者物價指數（CPI）表現不佳，加上油價高檔可能推升升息壓力、台幣面臨貶值風險，因而先將資金抽回美國，不宜直接解讀為看壞台積電基本面或明日法說會。

外資賣超前三大：南亞科、京元電子、台塑化

外資賣超前十大中，電子股占4檔、金融股3檔、ETF2檔，傳產股1檔。南亞科遭賣超2萬2967張，登上賣超榜首；京元電子以2萬2655張居次，台塑化則遭調節1萬9974張，排名第三。

值得關注的是，電子權值股也淪外資提款機，聯電遭賣超1萬6001張，排名第四；台積電遭賣超6752張，排名第12，以今日收盤價2490元估算，提款約168.12億元。

聯發科遭賣超3512張，排名第17，以收盤價4475元估算，提款約157.16億元。

外資買超前三大：中鋼、台塑、台玻

外資買超前十大中，傳產股占7檔，金融股、電子股及ETF各1檔。中鋼獲買超7萬7005張居冠，台塑以5萬3390張排名第二，台玻則獲加碼4萬6522張，三檔合計吸引外資買超17萬6917張。

仁寶則以1萬6300張排名第十，成為榜上唯一電子股。

外資再提款200億元 連6日賣超台股3330億元

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日延續賣超態勢，合計賣超153.97億元，其中外資再砍200.37億元，呈連6賣，累計賣超3,330.8億元。

投信今日則是續站買方，買超161.11億元，連續4個交易日買超508.86億元。

自營商則合計賣超114.71億元，其中自行買賣賣超25.1億元，避險操作賣超89.61億元，已呈連5賣，累計賣超1,092.68億元。

分析師：非看壞明日台積電法說

運達投顧分析師陳石輝表示，外資今日調節力道已明顯降低，且「今天不是追殺台積電」。昨日台積電一早開低、股價向下，今日則早盤維持紅盤，直到尾盤才出現賣壓，兩天的交易型態不同。研判外資今日抽回資金，與短線籌碼流動、匯率及總體經濟風險的關聯較大，「跟看好、看不好台積電，其實關係沒有很大」。

陳石輝認為，外資可能擔心今晚即將公布的美國9月消費者物價指數（CPI）表現不佳，加上油價仍處高檔，恐使升息壓力再起，進而增加美元走強、台幣續貶的風險。尤其昨日台幣明顯貶值，反映資金匯出的壓力，因此外資先行調整部位，屬於預防性動作。

至於賣超是否代表不看好台積電明日法說會，陳石輝不太認同。他認為，外資可以透過持有台積電的ETF和在美國交易的存託憑證（ADR）調整相關部位或進行對沖。若台積電明日下午法說會釋出好消息，外資當晚便能在美國市場買進ADR，重新參與行情。

「寧可賣台灣的台積電，但是如果台積電真的很好，再買美國的ADR。」陳石輝表示，這樣的操作思路，是先降低台幣資產曝險，再視法說結果以美元布局。因此，今日賣超較偏向資金與風險管理，不應沿用昨日廣泛、大幅調節台股的方式解讀。

美股四大指數全面收黑，台股今日仍反彈，加權指數盤中一度收復4萬9000點、最高衝上49059.12點，尾盤漲幅收斂，終場收在48625.83點、上漲284.52點。

news.Title: 台股反攻4萬9沒站穩 台積電收平盤.塑化續強
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者謝旻蓁,攝影蘇韋銘

台股周三止跌反彈，在台積電利多助攻下，指數一度大漲超過7百點，站回4萬9千點大關，中小型概念股也有買盤進駐，塑化族群多頭續攻，台塑、台化亮燈，南亞盤中也創新天價350.5元，其他像是矽光子、被動元件、面板等族群也輪番表態，不過尾盤台積電獲利了結賣壓出籠，股價跌回平盤價，大盤漲勢收斂，終場上漲284點，收在48625點，成交量達9286億元。

立委 羅民才：「覺得股市會觸及，會突破五萬點的請舉手，一個、兩個、三個、四個、五個。」

台股衝五萬內資信心滿滿，因為就在台積電法說會前夕，外資掀起目標價上修潮，最高喊到4410元，吸引資金提前卡位，股價領軍上漲，也為大盤注入一劑強心針，週三盤中上漲超過七百點，力拚站穩4萬9千點大關。

永誠國際投顧分析師 謝文琪：「在台股、亞股這部分其實都是有一個滿不錯的，一個跌深後的反彈，所以目前來看台股的話只要說，像成交量今天其實也是有預估到一兆以上的量。前波平台的最低點9月29日是47631點，只要沒有跌破47631點，那我認為這一波其實就是創新高的一個修正。如果台幣有稍微做一個轉升，那外資有沒有回來去停止轉賣變成轉買，那如果有的話，那其實我覺得對大盤的正向的加分效果會加大。」

盤面族群交投熱絡，台塑四寶股價續衝，南亞一度亮燈再刷新天價350.5元，台化也直奔漲停板，受惠於營收成長亮眼，矽光子概念股回神，華星光亮燈、聯亞漲半根停板，被動元件族群重拾多頭火種，面板三虎獲得買盤青睞，反觀先前漲勢暢旺的光學鏡頭概念股陷入拉回整理，記憶體則仍在消化長鑫存儲技術性突破消息，股價平盤震盪。不過專家認為，記憶體供給改善對AI發展是短空長多。

統一投顧總經理 廖婉婷：「如果這邊的供給瓶頸可以稍微克服的話，其實對於AI的整個零組件價格的壓力，我覺得是比較正面的。在明後年發展或者是備貨、拉貨會比較順的情況下，其實基建建造正向的話對於台灣的供應鏈都是好事。那這一次台積電法說市場也預期他會上修可能包括資本支出，然後第四季的展望也會因為輝達新平台的拉貨，還有GoogleTPU的拉貨，其實有機會開出一個雙位數的季成長。」

專家認為，隨著台股跌深反彈，加上台積電法說會即將登場，有望為市場注入多頭動能，不過短線要留意台幣匯率變化，以及外資買賣超動向掌握大盤後續走勢。（記者謝旻蓁／蘇韋銘 台北採訪報導）

news.Title: MIT dropout’s two startups announce shutdown weeks apart
news.Content: The landscape of American entrepreneurship is dotted with college dropouts founding tech startups that went on to become the world's biggest companies. For instance, Bill Gates dropped out of Harvard to co-found Microsoft . Mark Zuckerberg left Harvard after launching Facebook (now known as Meta). Whereas Steve Jobs left Reed College to co-found Apple , and Jack Dorsey left New York University to co-found Twitter (now called X) and the Bitcoin-centric fintech Block . All of these companies are among the world's most valued tech powerhouses, ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Two startups founded by MIT dropout Tieshun Roquerre, Namebase and Blur, have announced shutdowns.
• Blur, an NFT marketplace, is shutting down its website on November 12, with trading volume falling from $1.43 billion in March 2023 to less than $7 million in March 2026.
• Blast, an Ethereum layer-2 blockchain network also founded by Roquerre, saw its total value locked (TVL) drop from $2.19 billion in May 2024 to $24.81 million in September 2026.
• The shutdown of these ventures reflects a significant downturn in the NFT and crypto markets after their peak in 2021-2022.
• The article draws parallels to successful tech founders like Bill Gates (Microsoft) and Mark Zuckerberg (Meta) who also dropped out of college.
news.Keywords: startup, blockchain, NFT, crypto, market downturn

Almost always, you get hundreds of dollars off if you trade in your old phone. All of a sudden, upgrading doesn't seem so painful. However, that discount usually comes as monthly bill credits, tied to keeping an eligible phone plan for two or three years. The phone may feel cheaper, but you're making a longer commitment. It's a familiar bargain for millions of Americans. And Elon Musk's SpaceX ( SPCX ) ...
news.AI_Summary:
• SpaceX is exploring entry into the U.S. cellphone business, potentially challenging existing carriers like Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile.
• SpaceX's move could impact how Americans finance iPhones, as current carrier deals often tie discounts to long-term service commitments.
• The company is acquiring wireless spectrum, aiming to combine it with Starlink satellites for improved indoor phone signal coverage.
• Bank of America estimates that U.S. carriers provide approximately $42 billion in annual promotional value for iPhones through monthly bill credits.
• If SpaceX offers cheaper wireless plans without equivalent phone discounts, it could alter consumer upgrade cycles and potentially affect iPhone sales dynamics.
news.Keywords: telecom competition, wireless spectrum, iPhone financing, service plans, market disruption

news.Title: How much MSFT stock does Microsoft founder Bill Gates actually own?
news.Content: Everybody knows Bill Gates as the co-founder and longtime CEO of Microsoft. But Gates himself doesn't consider that to be his most important job . Gates, along with Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen, revolutionized the personal computing business in the 1970s and 80s. In the 1990s, Microsoft helped bring the Internet mainstream through its Windows operating system and Internet Explorer web browser. These innovations brought the company enormous success—and tremendous personal wealth. In 1987, at the age of 31, Gates became the world's youngest self-made billionaire. But just eight years ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Bill Gates personally holds approximately 103 million Microsoft (MSFT) shares, valued at around $55.9 billion as of October 13, 2026.
• The Gates Foundation Trust sold its remaining 7.7 million Microsoft shares in Q1 2026.
• Steve Ballmer remains the largest individual shareholder with an estimated 319 million shares (approx. 4% of the company).
• Bill Gates' peak ownership was a 49% stake (11.2 million shares) before Microsoft's 1986 IPO.
• Gates has significantly reduced his holdings over the years to focus on philanthropy through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.
news.Keywords: shareholder, stock holdings, philanthropy, IPO, valuation

news.Title: Franklin Templeton CEO says AI is hiding a bigger tech story
news.Content: Every gold rush has a quiet second act. The prospectors grab the headlines, but the people selling jeans, building railroads, and running the banks often walk away with the money. Wall Street has spent three years telling one story about technology. Chips, data centers, and power plants got the attention, and the stocks attached to them got the gains. That spending hasn't slowed. Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), Alphabet (GOOGL), Meta Platforms (META), Oracle (ORCL), and CoreWeave (CRWV) are on pace to pour about $785 billion into capital projects this year, with the total closing in on $1 trillion in 2027, ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Franklin Templeton CEO Jenny Johnson believes the current market focus on AI infrastructure (chips, data centers) is masking a larger technological story.
• Major tech companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle, and CoreWeave are projected to spend nearly $1 trillion on capital projects by 2027.
• Johnson suggests that real productivity gains from AI are yet to materialize as companies move from building infrastructure to utilizing it.
• A Federal Reserve survey indicates that about 70% of firms use AI, but over 80% report no impact on employment or productivity in the past three years.
• Johnson credits cloud computing and earlier digital advances for recent productivity gains, not AI, suggesting the AI payoff is still ahead.
news.Keywords: AI, productivity, capital expenditure, technology adoption, infrastructure

news.Title: Microsoft Reports $130 Billion in Data Center Leases
news.Content:
(Bloomberg) -- Microsoft Corp. reported more than $130 billion in new data center leases in the past quarter, signaling an accelerating pace of spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Most Read from Bloomberg

Epic Games Delays Disney Project, Asks Developers to Use More AI

Apple Unveils $299 HomeView Hub as Part of New Smart Home Push

Chip Selloff Sparks 7% Korea Rout on Brewing Worries Over AI

The company's total commitments for leases that have not yet commenced were $329.1 billion as of the quarter ended June 30, Microsoft said Wednesday in a regulatory filing. That's up from $196.6 billion in the prior period.

"That's really a signal of the continued demand strength that we see," Jonathan Neilson, Microsoft investor relations chief, said in an interview. "These leases are going to be there to serve demand for many many years."

The future costs, which come on top of active leases, won't appear on Microsoft's balance sheet until it begins making payments on them. The company said they are "primarily" for data centers and some are "subject to certain contractual conditions being met."

This represents Microsoft's largest quarterly jump in data center leasing by far. The software giant continues to be held back by a lack of data center capacity after taking a pause on its leasing activity through much of 2025.

news.Title: Investors Are Paying More for Walmart Than Amazon. Here’s Why That Doesn’t Add Up.
news.Content:
Walmart Inc. (NASDAQ: WMT ) has opened a fulfillment center of more than 900,000 square feet in Stockton, California. The site uses automation and machine learning to cut the usual 12-step order process down to five. It will also employ about 1,000 people. The company says its next-generation fulfillment centers, of which Stockton is the fifth, will enable it to reach 95% of the U.S. population with next-day or two-day shipping when combined with the rest of its network. The stock closed more than 2% higher on October 8, its fourth straight gain. Beyond its push for faster delivery, Walmart's defensive appeal remains a key attraction for investors. But which other companies joined WMT on our list of the 10 Best Bear Market Stocks to Invest In Right Now ?

Automation Is Changing Walmart's Business

I believe Stockton is just one piece of a much bigger shift. Walmart's U.S. e-commerce sales have grown more than 20% for 10 straight quarters, and fast deliveries jumped 48% last quarter. CFO John David Rainey said much of Walmart's recent spending has gone into supply chain automation and speed. That spending is also lifting higher-margin businesses. Advertising rose 38% last quarter, and membership fee revenue hit a record. Faster delivery brings more shoppers online, which feeds those businesses.

Still, Walmart remains a retailer at heart. Its stock fell 9% after its August report, despite beating estimates and raising its outlook. The decline reflected slow comparable sales and a soft Q3 guide, with operating income expected to grow just 2% to 4% as Walmart puts tariff refunds back into lower prices. Walmart's short-term margin pressure hasn't stopped hedge funds from backing the retail giant. See why WMT ranks No. 3 among the 10 Best Dividend Kings to Buy According to Hedge Funds and which other stocks made the list?

Walmart Costs More Than Amazon

Walmart's stock trades at a premium to its historical norms. The forward non-GAAP P/E of 37.48x sits about 24% above its 5-year average. That's even higher than Amazon, which trades at about 31x despite also owning AWS, a fast-growing, high-margin cloud business. The forward Price-to-sales ratio of 1.14x is also about 28% above its average. Yet analysts expect EPS to grow only 9% this fiscal year, about 12% in each of the next two, and 7% in fiscal 2030. Even based on fiscal 2030 earnings, the P/E would be around 28x. As of July 31, Walmart carried approximately $38.9 billion in net debt, excluding lease obligations. In my view, the automation story is big, but the stock already prices in a lot of it.

Story Continues

Hedge fund interest in Walmart is rising. Funds holding the stock rose from 99 in Q1 to 111 in Q2, while their stakes edged up from $10.9 billion to $11.1 billion.

Stockton shows Walmart is building a faster, more efficient business. At nearly 38 times earnings with about 10% annual growth, though, I'd wait for a better entry point.

While we acknowledge the risk and potential of WMT as an investment, our conviction lies in the belief that some AI stocks hold greater promise for delivering higher returns and doing so within a shorter time frame. It then looks at price momentum, meaning how each stock's recent price compares with its longer-term averages, and selects the 50 stocks with the strongest momentum. Holdings are weighted by market capitalization, subject to caps at the company and sector level, and the index is reconstituted quarterly.

The approach combines two signals: how bullish Wall Street analysts are on a stock, and whether the shares are actually trending higher.

RANK has a fund inception date of June 29, 2026, and had $12.43 million in net assets as of September 29, 2026.

What Changed

Compared with the fund's reported holdings as of June 30, 2026, the top of the portfolio looks different. Visa (V) , Coca-Cola (KO) and Bank of America (BAC) are new to the portfolio and now rank among its ten largest holdings. Walmart (WMT) , the fund's third-largest position at the end of June, is no longer in the portfolio, along with Broadcom (AVGO) and Alphabet (GOOGL) . Micron (MU) remains the largest holding, and Nvidia (NVDA) has moved up to second.

Here are the fund's five largest holdings as of September 30, 2026, along with how Wall Street analysts rate each one. Analyst data is from TipRanks as of October 12, 2026. Fund holdings are subject to change.

Micron

Micron Technology develops, manufactures and sells semiconductor memory and storage products. It is the largest holding in RANK at 9.21% of net assets, compared with 6.65% at June 30, 2026.

On TipRanks, the stock has a Strong Buy consensus rating. Of the 28 analysts who rated the stock over the past three months, 27 rated it a Buy. The average price target is $1,621.67.

Story Continues

Demand for memory chips from AI data centers has outpaced supply, which has supported memory prices and Micron's revenue.

Five-star TipRanks-rated Robert W.Baird analyst Tristan Gerra recently reiterated his Buy rating on Micron with a price target of $1,520. He also pointed to a steady path of gross margin expansion through fiscal 2027, supported by long‑term customer supply agreements that lock in pricing bands and secure a large share of Micron's future output and revenue through 2030.

Nvidia

Nvidia designs graphics processors, computing platforms and networking products used in AI data centers. It is the second-largest holding in RANK at 6.73% of net assets, compared with 4.51% at June 30, 2026.

On TipRanks, the analyst consensus on Nvidia is a Strong Buy. All 33 analysts who rated the stock over the past three months rated it a Buy. The average price target is $324.20.

Goldman Sachs analyst James Schneider recently maintained a Buy rating on Nvidia with a price target of $300. He pointed to the view that AI could reach a total addressable market of $3 trillion to $4 trillion by 2030, driven by the industry's shift from traditional retrieval-based computing toward generative models that require new, specialized compute infrastructure.

Schneider also cited Nvidia's tightly integrated hardware and networking stack as a structural advantage as customers seek higher performance and efficiency from their AI spending. He highlighted generative AI use cases in coding and cybersecurity, Nvidia's growing share of AI investment, and its ability to manage supply and data center capacity constraints.

Eli Lilly (LLY)

The pharmaceutical company, arguably best known for weight-loss drugs such as Zepbound, is the third-largest holding in RANK at 5.88% of net assets, compared with 4.60% at June 30, 2026.

On TipRanks, the stock has a Strong Buy consensus rating. Of the 23 analysts who rated the stock over the past three months, 20 rated it a Buy. The average price target is $1,366.05.

Lilly's revenue comes from a broad range of medicines, spanning weight-loss and diabetes treatments as well as cardiovascular and cancer drugs.

Berenberg analyst Kerry Holford recently upgraded the stock to Buy from Hold. She expects the drugmaker to exceed its 2026 guidance, driven by growth in weight-loss drug sales, and views Lilly as the market leader in obesity and diabetes medications.

Visa

Visa operates a global electronic payments network connecting consumers, merchants and financial institutions. New to the portfolio, it is the fourth-largest holding in RANK at 5.79% of net assets.

On TipRanks, the analyst consensus on Visa is a Strong Buy. Of the 28 analysts who rated the stock over the last three months, 26 rated it a Buy. The average price target is $425.54.

Visa's stock is up nearly 19% in the last six months driven by cross-border volumes and value-added services such as cybersecurity. It also received a boost from this summer's FIFA World Cup as fans enjoyed the football and wider hospitality.

Five-star TipRanks-rated Wolfe Research analyst Darrin Peller recently raised his price target on Visa to $460 from $435. He updated estimates, targets and ratings in the payments, consumer finance and IT services group following Q2 reports. He said that results across the sector demonstrated healthy U.S. consumer spending and credit trends.

Amazon (AMZN)

The e-commerce and cloud computing company is the fifth-largest holding in RANK at 5.72% of net assets, compared with 5.15% at June 30, 2026.

On TipRanks, the stock has a Strong Buy consensus rating. Of the 43 analysts who rated the stock over the past three months, 41 rated it a Buy. The average price target is $332.35.

Amazon's business is driven by consumer e-commerce and by Amazon Web Services, its cloud platform serving cloud and AI customers. On September 24, 2026, the company announced plans to invest more than $100 million in a new manufacturing facility in Greenwood, Indiana, to support its fulfillment and robotics network.

Evercore ISI analyst Mark Mahaney recently reiterated his Buy rating on the stock. He said Amazon is maintaining its leading share of U.S. online retail, with broad recognition for price, selection and convenience. He also sees upside from newer growth drivers, including agentic AI, which he said is already driving incremental product discovery, and faster shipping.

The Takeaway

RANK is designed to reflect two signals at once: analyst conviction and price momentum. Rather than relying on a single analyst's view, the index draws on Buy recommendations from all analysts in the TipRanks database who cover a stock, then keeps the companies whose shares are also showing the strongest price momentum.

Because the index is reconstituted every quarter, the portfolio changes as analyst views and price trends shift, and this latest update reflects that. Analyst ratings and price targets are opinions, not guarantees, and momentum can reverse quickly.

news.Title: Microsoft’s New AI Model Is 35 Times Faster Than OpenAI’s GPT-6 Sol. Wait Until You See the Price Tag.
news.Content:
On Oct. 9, CEO Satya Nadella announced that Microsoft (MSFT) has released a new AI model called Microsoft-Decision-1. Most AI models, like ChatGPT, write text and work through problems step by step. This one does something narrower. It makes quick choices, such as picking a category, sorting requests, or deciding an AI agent's next move. Microsoft says it runs about 35 times faster than OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol on these tasks. It's available through Microsoft Foundry and OpenRouter.

Why Cheap Decisions Matter

Then there's the price, which is almost too low to believe. Decision-1 costs $0.042 per million input tokens, and output is free. OpenAI's own decision model charges more than twice that. Price matters here because AI agents make dozens of small choices before finishing a single task. Running a large model for each one quickly gets slow and expensive. Microsoft's Xbox research team saw this firsthand. It used Decision-1 to sort over 10,000 pieces of player feedback. The model matched GPT-6 Sol in quality while running more than 14 times faster at about 1/200th of the cost.

​There's also a strategic angle many investors may overlook. Microsoft built Decision-1 on an open-source model from Alibaba's (BABA) Qwen family and plans to rebuild it later on with its own models and OpenAI's. That flexibility shows that Microsoft can build useful AI tools without depending on a single partner. If agents spread across businesses as Microsoft expects, cheap decision models like this could make them far more affordable to run.

​About Microsoft Stock

Microsoft Corporation is a global technology company that develops and sells a wide range of software, cloud services, devices, and business solutions, serving both individual users and enterprise customers worldwide. Its flagship products include Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure, LinkedIn, and Xbox. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Redmond, Washington.

Over the last 12 months, MSFT shares have gained 5%, underperforming the S&P 500's ($SPX) 17% rise during the same period. The stock hit its 52-week high in October 2025 but started falling after that. However, this year the stock is up 14% year-to-date (YTD), slightly outperforming the S&P 500's 13% gain over the same period.

Story Continues

Microsoft trades slightly below its historical valuation, which stands out given where its growth is heading. The forward non-GAAP price-to-earnings (P/E) of 27.07x is about 11% under its 5-year average of 30.50x. That discount is unusual because analysts expect growth to speed up. EPS is forecast to rise about 14% this fiscal year, then roughly 20% to 22% over the following two. I think the discount mostly reflects worries about how much Microsoft is spending on AI. As I covered earlier, that includes massive projects like its Fairwater data center in Wisconsin. That's where tools like Decision-1 come in. If cheaper AI models help those investments pay off sooner, Microsoft could return to its usual multiple and possibly earn a premium, given how fast its earnings are expected to grow.

Microsoft Guides for Strong Q1 Revenue

Microsoft Corp reported its fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings on July 29. It reported revenue of $90.01 billion, up 18% year-over-year (YoY). The earnings per share came in at $4.74, comfortably beating the Wall Street consensus of $4.24. The company said fiscal 2026 was its strongest year yet. The company's cloud business remained the main growth engine. Microsoft Cloud revenue exceeded $214 billion for the year, up 27%, while Azure passed $100 billion in annual revenue. Gross margin for the quarter was down 67% YoY because of a mix shift and AI infrastructure spending. However, the operating margin was 45%, slightly higher than a year earlier. The results indicated that Microsoft is still growing rapidly even at its large scale.

Looking forward, CFO Amy Hood guided Q1 fiscal 2027 total revenue to be between $89.85 billion and $90.95 billion. The company expects Azure growth to remain strong, with revenue in Intelligent Cloud projected at $40.95 billion to $41.25 billion for the quarter. For Productivity and Business Processes, the company guided revenue of $36.7 billion to $37 billion. Moreover, capital spending is likely to remain high, with first-quarter spending above $50 billion, including lease reclassification effects.

What Do Analysts Expect for MSFT Stock?

Barclays analyst Raimo Lenschow maintained a "Buy" rating on MSFT and set a price target of $600. Similarly, Deutsche Bank analyst Brad Zelnick reiterated a "Buy" rating while raising the firm's price target from $550 to $600. In contrast to these two, Phillip Securities downgraded MSFT to a "Hold" rating with a price target of $515.

Based on 51 Wall Street analysts covering the stock, MSFT holds a consensus "Strong Buy" rating. However, its mean price target of $579.78 suggests just 6% upside from current levels, indicating limited near-term gains at the average estimate. The high price target of $725 implies 33% upside, showing that some analysts see considerably greater potential.

news.Title: How to Play Microsoft Stock Ahead of an Upcoming Maia 300 Launch
news.Content:
The war for artificial intelligence (AI) supremacy has a new central battleground, and it is inference. Apart from the established winners of the training era, such as Nvidia (NVDA) and AMD (AMD), hyperscalers are increasingly becoming important players here by making their own custom AI chips.

Alphabet's (GOOG) (GOOGL) Google, with its TPUs, got a head start; however, Microsoft (MSFT), with the launch of the Maia 300 AI chip in 2027, is not willing to cede ground. Promising 40% more token output per megawatt than the GPU systems dominated by Nvidia and AMD, the company has developed the chip with a focus on inference. To be manufactured through TSMC's (TSM) leading 2nm process, Microsoft said in a statement, "Maia 300 is designed with an inference-first architecture optimized for long-context, memory-intensive and decode-heavy AI workloads. This involves balancing compute, memory bandwidth, networking and power efficiency at cloud scale."

Having said that, how does Maia 300 fit into Microsoft's wider AI strategy? Let's find out.

Mai(a) Own

Why are hyperscalers like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon (AMZN) spending billions to build their own chips? The chips from Nvidia and AMD are fulfilling their needs quite well at the moment, and the duo is in a constant mode of building new and more powerful generations of chips. Moreover, the hyperscalers are buying them as well, clearly signalling that even if they are developing their own chips, they will continue to source the ones produced by Nvidia and AMD.

Then, why? Well, there are a few reasons. First, the companies want to reduce their dependence on outsiders, specifically Nvidia, which has an almost hegemonic presence in the GPU market, which in turn gives it immense pricing power, leaving the hyperscalers vulnerable. Secondly, custom chips are cheaper (in terms of cost per AI workload) than those from the likes of Nvidia and AMD, and thirdly, the companies can build their own chips to cater to their particular needs and focus on aspects they want to. Finally, designing their own chips facilitates tighter integration between their processors, software, and broader data-center infrastructure, potentially improving performance while creating differentiated offerings for cloud customers.

Story Continues

Specifically with Microsoft, Maia 300 is a continuation of its attempt to get more AI work done inside the power and cooling limits of its data centers. Each Maia 300 accelerator is designed with 288 gigabytes of HBM4 memory and 18 TB/s of peak memory bandwidth. That bandwidth is two and a half times Maia 200's. Notably, Microsoft plans to put 96 accelerators in a rack drawing 167 kilowatts, with 27.6 terabytes of memory across the rack. It says that the configuration can generate up to seven times as many tokens per rack as Maia 200.

Ultimately, Microsoft intends to make Maia its primary inference system as it expands the family beginning in 2027. It names Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Foundry, and Dragon Copilot among the services that could benefit from the architecture. For a customer, the expected result is quicker responses or greater capacity when many people are using those services, not a new processor they must install. Lower serving cost might also allow Microsoft more room to price AI features competitively, though it has not promised a customer price cut yet.

Microsoft's Outstanding Q2

Microsoft reported solid financial performance as revenue advanced 18% year-over-year (YoY) to $90 billion, coming in $2.4 billion ahead of forecasts. The Intelligent Cloud segment, which includes Azure, grew 31.5% YoY to $39.31 billion. While operating margins for the segment remained roughly unchanged from the previous year, absolute operating income increased 31.4% to $15.96 billion. Azure revenue specifically rose 43% YoY, exceeding the expected range of 39% to 40%. For the full year, Azure crossed a $100 billion run rate for the first time. Commercial backlog nearly doubled YoY to $684 billion, with about 30% of that total expected to convert to revenue over the next twelve months, highlighting strong demand for the company's cloud products and services.

Earnings per share increased 23% to $4.74, surpassing the consensus estimate of $4.24 and extending the streak of consecutive earnings beats to nine quarters. This result includes a $3.2 billion gain associated with the company's investment in Anthropic, the developer of Claude.

Cash flow stayed robust, as net cash from operations climbed to $55.44 billion, reflecting a 30% rise from the year-earlier period. Microsoft ended the quarter with $76.8 billion in cash, substantially higher than its short-term debt of $9.23 billion.

From a valuation perspective, MSFT appears reasonably valued. The forward P/E and P/S of 27.07 and 10.15 are above the sector medians of 23.29 and 3.53, respectively, while on a forward P/CF basis, MSFT stock is trading at 17.43, lower than the sector median of 20.95.

What Do Analysts Think of MSFT Stock?

Thus, analysts have earmarked an overall rating of "Strong Buy" for MSFT stock. The mean target price of $579.78 indicates a potential upside of about 6% from current levels. Out of the 51 analysts covering the stock, 41 have a "Strong Buy" rating, five have a "Moderate Buy" rating, four have a "Hold" rating, and one has a "Strong Sell" rating.

news.Title: Deutsche Bank Sees Major Reckoning Ahead for AI Investors
news.Content: This article first appeared on GuruFocus . Deutsche Bank says artificial intelligence could theoretically reach superintelligence by 2030 , but only if model scaling continues, AI systems learn to improve themselves and the industry can overcome enormous constraints around power, infrastructure and financing. Is GOOG fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator. The bank's Research Institute said the path depends heavily on whether future AI systems can autonomously improve the technology used to build the next generation of models. But the physical requirements are staggering. Deutsche Bank estimates that training a hypothetical AGI-like model could require $300 billion to $500 billion of infrastructure and roughly 6 gigawatts of power . Running an equivalent training cycle in just four months using Nvidia (NVDA) Vera Rubin chips could require approximately 7.8 million chips and 26 gigawatts of facility power , with the infrastructure costing about $900 billion at today's prices . The bank estimates a comparable cluster could fall to roughly $200 billion by 2030 if current improvements in computing efficiency continue. The industry is already spending aggressively. Alphabet ( NASDAQ:GOOG ), Amazon ( NASDAQ:AMZN ), Meta ( NASDAQ:META ), Microsoft ( NASDAQ:MSFT ) and Oracle ( NYSE:ORCL ) are expected to invest almost $800 billion in capital expenditures this year , according to Deutsche Bank, with annual spending potentially exceeding $1 trillion through 2030 and beyond . Yet the bank stressed that the AI investment case does not require superintelligence. AI adoption by businesses is reportedly advancing roughly three times faster than previous mobile, internet and cloud computing waves , while AI-economy revenue outside China could exceed $200 billion in 2026 , up from less than $1 billion in 2022. Investor Takeaway I think the most important part of Deutsche Bank's report is not the 2030 superintelligence prediction itself. It is the sheer economic and physical infrastructure required even to attempt it . The numbers show why companies such as Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet could continue benefiting from massive AI spending even if true superintelligence remains elusive. But there is also a clear risk. Much of today's infrastructure spending is being financed on expectations of future revenue rather than cash flows already being generated. Deutsche Bank highlighted growing pressure on hyperscaler free cash flow as capex rises. Google DeepMind's Jasjeet Sekhon described the danger as an AI air pocket where spending arrives first but the expected revenue fails to follow. Story Continues For investors, I would watch hyperscaler capex, AI revenue growth, data-center power availability, financing costs and improvements in compute efficiency . If revenues scale alongside spending, the buildout can continue. If monetization lags too far behind infrastructure investment, capital rather than technology could become the biggest obstacle long before 2030. news.Title: Zuckerberg Admits Meta Lacked AI Certainty on $200 Billion Bet
news.Content:
(Bloomberg) -- Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg said Meta Platforms Inc. had to commit to spending hundreds of billions of dollars last year on the infrastructure needed to power its artificial intelligence products before the company had any idea as to whether they would succeed.

Most Read from Bloomberg

"We're going to write this check for like, I don't know, $100 billion or $200 billion," Zuckerberg said on the Cheeky Pint podcast posted Monday. "You sure this is going to work?" he recalled asking Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang.

It's a revealing disclosure for a company that has struggled to persuade investors to accept its ballooning expenses for ambitious AI bets. Zuckerberg has repeatedly said these bets will pay off, but shareholders are growing increasingly antsy over Meta's ability to bring in sales and profit at a fast enough pace.

Over the course of the two-hour-plus podcast with host John Collison, Zuckerberg and Wang revealed that Meta's Chief Financial Officer Susan Li warned on multiple occasions that the cost of failure would be enormous. "I think Susan scared you a little bit," Zuckerberg said.

"The joke every time we talked about it would just be like, 'Yeah, and we hope it's all going to work and be good,'" Wang recalled. Short of giving a "vibe report" on where the team was headed, he could not guarantee success despite the "obscenely large" amount of money the company was investing. It was "not clear at all that it was going to work."

On Monday, Meta debuted a long-awaited new AI model that it said is a big leap over its own predecessors, with "frontier capabilities" that its leadership said put it on par with OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic PBC's Claude when it comes to coding, or working through financial or legal questions. The milestone will test whether Zuckerberg's multibillion-dollar push to rebuild its AI team has improved the technology enough to compete among leaders.

Meta also recently launched Muse, its personalized AI assistant designed to automate a range of tasks for consumers, including shopping, buying movie tickets and scheduling appointments. Zuckerberg admitted he wasn't sure what the consumer reaction would be like to Muse.

Story Continues

"Our median expectation was like, 'All right, we're probably going to have to like iterate on this a bit,'" he said.

The company is spending hundreds of billions of dollars to compete against American tech rivals, including Alphabet Inc., OpenAI and Anthropic, in a race to develop leading AI models and products. It is one of the tech industry's heaviest spenders when it comes to AI data centers.

Next week, investors will get another look at the company's financials when it reports results after the market closes on Oct. 21. Last quarter, Meta reported its lowest free cash flow in years — a sign of its compounding expenses on data centers and smart glasses — sending shares down 8%.

The stock is up more than 12% so far this year through Monday's close.

news.Title: Cathie Wood Trims $3.3 Million in Top Tech Stock
news.Content: This article first appeared on GuruFocus . Cathie Wood's ARK Invest trimmed its Meta Platforms ( NASDAQ:META ) position on Monday, selling roughly $3.36 million worth of shares while putting fresh capital into a group of biotechnology companies. ARK sold 4,520 Meta shares through the ARK Innovation ETF. Based on Meta's closing price of $742.96, the transaction was worth about $3.36 million. Is META fairly valued? The sale is notable because ARK had aggressively added to Meta in September, suggesting the latest move may represent profit-taking or portfolio rebalancing rather than a wholesale change in conviction. Meta shares surged about 25% in September , helped partly by investor enthusiasm around the company's expanding AI strategy. That includes Muse , Meta's AI assistant designed to handle complex, multistep tasks such as booking travel, sending emails and completing transactions. Meta also introduced Muse Wonder , a more advanced family of AI models that CEO Mark Zuckerberg said pushes the company closer to the frontier of artificial intelligence. While trimming Meta, ARK was active on the buy side in biotech. The firm purchased roughly $2.56 million of Alamar Biosciences , around $2.34 million of CRISPR Therapeutics, $2.16 million of Freenome and $2.13 million of Guardant Health. ARK also added shares of Nurix Therapeutics, Intellia Therapeutics and Beam Therapeutics. The firm separately sold about $4.49 million of DraftKings across two of its ETFs. Investor Takeaway I think the most important thing here is not that Cathie Wood suddenly turned bearish on Meta. The timing suggests something more nuanced. ARK had been buying Meta heavily before a strong September rally, so selling a relatively modest $3.36 million position after a 25% monthly gain could simply reflect portfolio discipline. At the same time, ARK is rotating capital toward biotech names where valuations and upside potential may look more asymmetric. That fits Wood's broader strategy of backing disruptive technologies across multiple industries rather than remaining overly concentrated in one winner. For Meta investors, I would focus less on this single ARK trade and more on AI monetization, Muse adoption, advertising growth and whether Meta can turn its expanding AI ecosystem into meaningful incremental revenue . For ARK watchers, the bigger signal is the growing allocation toward genomics and biotech as Wood searches for the next major innovation cycle. news.Title: Is Western Digital (WDC) a Good or Bad Investment at Today’s Price?
news.Content:
Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ: WDC ) closed at $397.28 on October 9. The stock has returned 13.4% during the last six months, compared to a 24.3% return for the Insider Monkey Billionaire Index and 15.1% for State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust.

Western Digital reports a net margin no hardware manufacturer has ever sustained. Storage has a long history of destroying anyone who mistakes a shortage for a moat. This is a shortage.

READ ALSO: 10 Best Undervalued Stocks to Buy in October

The Profit Came From a Shareholding, Not From Drives:

No storage company keeps nearly three-quarters of its revenue as profit, and this one did not either. Western Digital separated its flash memory business as SanDisk in February 2025 and retained a stake. Accounting rules require that retained interest be marked to market, and SanDisk shares rose a long way. The resulting gain is most of the reported profit.

The cash statement confirms it plainly. Free cash flow came in at a fraction of reported net income, and that spread is the shareholding rather than the drives. Strip it out and what remains is genuinely strong, because the operating margin of 43.61% belongs to Western Digital and it is a remarkable number for storage hardware. Revenue grew 43.80% as data centres bought high-capacity drives faster than the industry could build them, on a balance sheet carrying barely a billion of debt. The stake itself is in a chip business, which is the sector doing the work here and the reason so much money sits in the semiconductors billionaires added to this year . Their most-held name is up 18% since June.

DON'T MISS: 10 Best Stocks to Buy for High Returns in 2026

This Is What a Cycle Top Looks Like:

Storage is cyclical, and this is what the top of a cycle looks like. Drive prices rose because buyers wanted capacity faster than it could be manufactured, not because Western Digital won share.

That matters for how the multiple should be read. A cyclical trades at its lowest earnings multiple precisely when its earnings are highest, which is the opposite of a bargain signal. Micron spent years looking cheap on exactly this arithmetic and expensive once memory pricing turned.

Capacity is already being added across the industry, which is the predictable response to margins like these. The question is not whether supply arrives but when. Cheapest multiple at the highest earnings is the oldest trap in commodities, and avoiding it is most of what separates a cyclical from the high return list we published in January . The one we ranked first there is up 24% since.

Story Continues

The shares rose over six months without keeping pace with the market, and they still sit far below their 52-week high, which gives some sense of how violent the swings here are.

The Valuation Case:

On earnings, the stock trades at 12.40 times forward, on analyst consensus estimates, and that figure is not a bargain signal for the reasons above. The price-to-book of 18.99 is the measure that does not flatter the company, and it is the one that survives a pricing reversal. You are paying nineteen times the stated value of the assets for a manufacturer at a cyclical peak.

The verdict is that Western Digital looks cheap on peak earnings and expensive on assets, which is the classic profile of a cyclical at the top. Both things are true, and only one of them persists through a downturn. The operating business deserves credit, and the price does not reflect a permanent rerating. Profit that does not depend on a shortage is a different kind of cheap altogether, and that is what the profitable stocks we judged most underpriced are built on. Their leader has returned 16% since.

Conclusion:

Two businesses are buried in this income statement, and only one of them makes drives. The one that does grew revenue sharply at an exceptional operating margin, on a balance sheet carrying almost no debt. However, the net margin comes mostly from marking a retained SanDisk shareholding, and free cash flow arrived well below reported net income. The forward multiple is what a storage company looks like at the top of a pricing cycle rather than what a cheap one looks like. Everything comes back to price-to-book, the one figure that does not fall away when drive prices do.

Market Sentiment:

Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) was held by 98 hedge funds with a combined stake value of about $9.94 billion at the end of Q2 2026 in the Insider Monkey database. This is up from 83 hedge fund holders with a cumulative investment value of around $6.57 billion in the previous quarter.

While we acknowledge the risk and potential of WDC as an investment, our conviction lies in the belief that some AI stocks hold greater promise for delivering higher returns and doing so within a shorter time frame. If you are looking for an AI stock that is more promising than WDC and that has 10,000% upside potential, check out our report about this cheapest AI stock .

news.Title: S&P upgrades SanDisk to BBB as AI memory demand drives cash flow past $23B
news.Content:
Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK). to 'BBB' from 'BB+' on Monday, citing a sharp surge in artificial intelligence-driven demand for memory chips and a pristine, debt-free balance sheet. The credit rating agency maintained a stable outlook for the NAND flash memory producer, highlighting robust cash generation and significant financial cushion to absorb potential industry downturns.

Before you buy NVIDIA: our AI model's stock picks are beating the market by 120%+. See the list now »

The upgrade follows a transformative period of growth for SanDisk, driven by a tight supply-demand imbalance in the global flash memory market. Fueled by exponential growth in AI data center infrastructure, the company posted a 175% revenue surge in fiscal 2026 as pricing skyrocketed across all business segments.

Not finding the right stocks? Our AI's list of investor-grade stock picks for October just dropped »

Looking ahead, S&P expects SanDisk's momentum to accelerate into fiscal 2027, projecting revenue to double and free cash flow to surpass $23 billion. Operating profitability is anticipated to expand further as the company ramps up lower-cost technology and benefits from high-margin data center contracts featuring volume commitments and price protections.

While memory markets remain historically cyclical and prone to sudden price corrections, SanDisk's conservative balance sheet structure provides substantial risk mitigation. The company repaid all of its funded debt earlier in the year and is expected to maintain a net cash position even as capital expenditures increase and excess capital is returned to shareholders.

Against that backdrop, long-term supply agreement commitments from data center customers are providing enhanced earnings visibility compared to traditional PC and mobile markets. news.Title: Why Lumentum Sank Today
news.Content:
Shares of optical leader Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) sank on Monday, falling 9.8%.

Lumentum has been a key beneficiary of the AI build-out, as optical lasers are increasingly important for achieving the speeds required for AI training and inference. Last week, Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston said in a Bloomberg interview that the company was "almost sold out" for 2029, sending shares to an all-time high.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

However, concerns over the sustainability of the AI boom came to the fore over the weekend when another AI company CEO said many investors are treating it like a "casino."

Broadcom CEO Hock Tan curbs AI enthusiasm

Over the weekend, Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) CEO Hock Tan spoke at an industry conference in Singapore. At that conference, he said many investors don't really know what they are investing in, and that they, "set very extreme expectations only to find out that it's almost like they are in a casino."

Tan went on to note that while leading AI companies, such as OpenAI , are generating significant revenue at the moment, it remains unclear whether they will have a sustainable, profitable business model that justifies the enormous amount of current AI spending. He noted that enterprises are using many AI tokens, but mostly in an experimental manner that isn't necessarily economical in the long run:

When you are a kid, you go to a video arcade and play. Your parents give you $10 of tokens, you finish it in 10 minutes and you haven't learned anything... That's what happening in enterprises today."

Those comments appeared to generate a big pullback in the main AI infrastructure stocks on Monday. Given that Lumentum has been one of the big winners, surging to all-time highs last week, it's no wonder its stock is down even more than other chip stocks today.

Lumentum's bull case remains as long as the AI story remains as well

Optical laser stocks have rallied so much this year because the network requirements of AI usage are spurring not only an increase in the number of data centers, and communications between those data centers, but also the replacement of copper wiring by optical connections within server racks and even servers themselves.

This compounding growth is why optical stocks remain attractive; however, this depends on the overall health and need for AI data centers. Hock Tan threw some cold water on the growth thesis over the weekend, but his statements were far from declaring the AI build-out a "bubble" that will inevitably burst. The bull case could remain intact, as long as end users eventually get value from the technology, and sustainable AI business models are developed.

news.Title: AI Is Blowing Up Tech’s Money Rules. How Arm Could Make Qualcomm Pay More.
news.Content:
Artificial intelligence is doing more than changing what technology companies sell. It is testing the agreements that decide who gets paid when those products succeed. A licensing deal that looked sensible in the smartphone era can look painfully cheap once the same technology powers sprawling data centers. Meanwhile, content once given away to attract readers has become raw material for competing AI services.

Investors riding the AI infrastructure spending boom should take note: owning essential technology doesn't guarantee a bigger share of its value.

More News from Barchart

'When You Say I Should Pay $100 Billion, Then I'm Starting To Do A Little Math': Bill Gates Said He'd Happily Pay 'Over $10 Billion In Taxes' But Some Are Asking Too Much

Dan Ives Calls SpaceX's $40B Nvidia Chip Debt Plan a 'Smart Move'

Dear Johnson & Johnson Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for October 13

Get exclusive insights with the FREE Barchart Brief newsletter. Subscribe now for quick, incisive midday market analysis you won't find anywhere else.

Qualcomm and Arm's $1.88 Problem

That tension is on full display in the courtroom fight between Qualcomm (QCOM) and Arm Holdings (ARM) over an architecture licensing agreement dating to 2013. Oddly, Arm is now criticizing the very terms it wrote.

According to Reuters , the agreement caps royalties at $1.88 per chip containing at least five processor cores. Arm's lawyer contrasted that with data center processors containing 288 cores, asking whether Qualcomm was paying for five and "getting 283 for free." Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon rejected that characterization.

The stakes cut both ways. For Qualcomm, a capped fee protects margins as its chips grow more capable. For Arm, it limits the revenue it can capture from that growing complexity. And because Qualcomm's license runs through 2033, access to future technology, and what it costs, is central to the dispute.

Arm has another route to monetization, though. Its June-quarter SEC filing describes the March 2026 launch of its own AGI CPU, underscoring a shift from licensing toward selling silicon.

A little arithmetic shows why this matters. On a hypothetical $100 chip, a $1.88 royalty is 1.88% of sales. On a $1,000 chip, it shrinks to 0.188%. These are illustrations, not Qualcomm's actual prices, but they show how a fixed fee lets a chipmaker keep more revenue as product value rises. A pricier chip also costs more to design and build, so the difference isn't pure profit.

Still, the distinction is useful. Arm shareholders should separate more chips shipped from more revenue earned per chip. Qualcomm shareholders face the opposite question: how much of today's cost advantage will survive negotiations over tomorrow's technology?

Story Continues

AI Is Repricing Content Too

A similar reset is underway online. Reddit (RDDT) disclosed in its 2024 IPO prospectus that its January data-licensing agreements totaled $203 million over two to three years. That figure is the contracted value, not cash already collected. Because these contracts are shorter than Arm's, Reddit gets more frequent chances to revisit pricing.

Charging AI companies has its own trade-off, however. Their answers can reduce the need to visit the original source, and Reddit's slowing user growth shows that monetizing content and protecting audience engagement are separate challenges.

Microsoft (MSFT) took a different approach on Feb. 3 with its Publisher Content Marketplace, which lets publishers set licensing terms and provides usage reporting. The announcement explicitly acknowledged that the web's old bargain of content in exchange for referral traffic doesn't translate cleanly to AI.

Key Takeaway

As for the Qualcomm-Arm case, Reuters reports that the Delaware jury deliberated for roughly four hours on Oct. 9 without reaching a verdict and plans to return on Oct. 13. But the tension over these contracts will remain whichever way the jury decides.

AI demand alone is an incomplete investment thesis. The better bets are businesses that can turn rising usage into cash without undermining customer relationships or their original source of revenue.

For now, keep QCOM and ARM stocks on your watchlist rather than buying either on courtroom speculation. Watch for the verdict, future licensing terms, and evidence that Arm's silicon expansion produces profitable growth. Arm's $1.88 fee illustrates the problem, but it is enforceable pricing power that determines who collects the payoff.
